Name: -1_3sat_np_feathers_proof
Representative_Docs: ['The specification discloses a model training data generation method, a device, a storage medium and an electronic device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a generated processing model and target field data, determining field data characteristics corresponding to the target field data and model processing labels of the field data characteristics, performing label updating processing on the model processing labels of the field data characteristics based on the field data characteristics to obtain a target field model training data set, and finally performing model training on the generated processing model by adopting the target field model training data set subjected to the label updating processing.', 'The embodiment of the application provides an image processing method, an image processing device, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium, and relates to the fields of games, artificial intelligence and cloud technology. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a first image and a second image which are scene images of the same virtual scene in different versions of the same application, obtaining an image to be combined based on the first image and the second image, splicing the first image, the second image and the image to be combined to obtain an image to be processed, inputting the image to be processed into a trained image processing model, extracting difference characteristics between the first image and the second image based on the image to be processed, and predicting an image recognition result based on the difference characteristics. According to the embodiment of the application, manual participation is not needed when the effective difference is identified, so that the identification efficiency is greatly improved, and the identification accuracy can be improved.', 'The application discloses a model training method which can be applied to the field of artificial intelligence and comprises the steps of obtaining a first neural network model and a training sample, applying target parameter value disturbance to target parameters in the first neural network model to obtain a second neural network model, processing the training sample through the second neural network model to obtain target loss, and carrying out model training on the first neural network model according to the target loss to obtain an updated first neural network model. The method acquires the loss obtained after the first neural network model with the parameter disturbance is processed by the second neural network model, and the loss can represent the difference between the data processing result of the first neural network model after the parameter disturbance and the true value, so that the data processing precision of the model is not greatly influenced when the updated first neural network model obtained by model training based on the loss has the parameter disturbance.']

Name: 0_recommendation_user_content_product
Representative_Docs: ['The embodiment of the application provides a content recommendation method and device, which are used for acquiring a content request initiated by user equipment aiming at a target object; responding to the content request, selecting a target recommendation rule matched with the target object according to the corresponding relation between a pre-configured object and the recommendation rule, and acquiring user data corresponding to the user; recommending target content corresponding to the target object to the user equipment according to the user data and the target recommendation rule.', 'The embodiment of the specification provides a recommendation method and device based on reinforcement learning. In the recommendation method, in response to a recommendation request of a user for a continuous recommendation scene, continuous recommendation is performed for the user in the following manner until the recommendation is finished: acquiring current state information of a user; determining a next batch of recommended content according to the reinforcement learning algorithm by using the recommendation model and the current state information; and pushing the next recommended content to the user, wherein the next recommended content is used as the current recommended content of the next recommending process in the continuous recommendation, the action sequence of the reinforcement learning algorithm comprises a recommended content sequence based on the feedback behavior of the user, the environment state of the reinforcement learning algorithm comprises the state information of the user, and the return of the reinforcement learning algorithm comprises the service feedback information based on the feedback behavior of the user.', 'The invention provides a sequence recommending method and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring data of a user, wherein the data is divided into a training set and a testing set, the training set is used for training parameters of a sequence recommendation model, and the testing set is used for testing effects of the sequence recommendation model; constructing a sequence recommendation model; the sequence recommendation model adopts a long-term short-term self-attention sequence recommendation method; training the sequence recommendation model by using a training set; testing the effect of the sequence recommendation model by using a test set; inputting the user characteristics, the recommended candidate item set characteristics and feedback data of the user into a trained sequence recommendation model to obtain comprehensive preference of the user, estimating the preference degree of the user for the recommended candidate items in the candidate recommended item set through the comprehensive preference, recommending items with high preference degree ranking to the user, and completing recommendation. The comprehensive preference of the user can be obtained through the user characteristics, the recommended candidate item set characteristics and the user feedback data.']

Name: 1_fault_diagnosis_bearing_vibration
Representative_Docs: ['The application relates to the technical field of computer internal detection, and discloses a computer anomaly detection method and a system, wherein the method collects data through a data acquisition module, processes and extracts characteristics of the collected data through a specific algorithm, selects the processed and extracted characteristics to train a model, establishes a fault detection model, models a fault detection problem through a random forest classifier, and verifies the validity of the model through experiments, through the feature data set corresponding to the fault features and the construction of the fault diagnosis model, the fault diagnosis model is trained according to the feature data set based on the machine learning method to obtain an optimized fault diagnosis model, and then the fault analysis and the fault recognition are rapidly and accurately carried out on the computer hardware according to the optimized fault diagnosis model, so that the efficiency of fault diagnosis and the reliability of system operation are improved, and the software and hardware faults are accurately diagnosed in a complex computer system.', 'The application discloses an improved fault diagnosis method, device, equipment and medium for an air processor, and relates to the technical field of fault diagnosis, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring operation data when the air processor fails by using a sensor; inputting the operation data into a trained fault diagnosis model to obtain a fault type output by the fault diagnosis model; the fault diagnosis model is obtained by training a fault classifier based on training samples, the training samples are composed of real fault samples and generated fault samples with the quality exceeding the preset sample quality, and the generated fault samples are generated from the real fault samples by a CWGAN network based on a multi-head self-attention mechanism. According to the application, the fault diagnosis model capable of completing AHU fault diagnosis can be obtained by using a small amount of real fault data, and compared with the existing fault diagnosis method of the air conditioner air processor, the accuracy and stability of the fault diagnosis model obtained through training are obviously improved.', 'The invention belongs to the field of fault diagnosis, and discloses a bearing fault diagnosis method based on a convolutional neural network and a Gaussian mixture model. The method comprises the following steps: (a) for a rotating mechanical bearing, acquiring vibration signals under different fault working conditions to form a data set, and constructing an initial convolutional neural network model; (b) training an initial convolutional neural network model corresponding to each fault type; (c) performing feature extraction on the vibration signal input by adopting a final convolution neural network model so as to obtain one-dimensional feature data corresponding to all fault types and form a one-dimensional feature data set; (d) obtaining a final graph model for diagnosing the fault type by adopting a Gaussian mixture model, a Bayesian network framework and an EM algorithm; (e) and for the vibration signal to be diagnosed, diagnosing the fault type corresponding to the vibration signal to be diagnosed by using the final graph model, thereby realizing the diagnosis of the fault. By the method and the device, the fault diagnosis of the graph model is realized, and the accuracy of the fault diagnosis is improved.']

Name: 2_quantum_qubit_circuit_qubits
Representative_Docs: ['A quantum computing device initiates a first quantum algorithm comprising a test method implemented as a quantum oracle, the first quantum algorithm receiving an input of a first quantum register comprising one or more qubits and a second quantum register comprising one qubit, each qubit in the first quantum register corresponding to a test case for the test method. The quantum computing device receives an output of the first quantum algorithm. The quantum computing device initiates a second quantum algorithm, the second quantum algorithm receiving an input of a third quantum register and the output of the first quantum algorithm. The quantum computing device performs a measurement on the first quantum register and a measurement on the third quantum register. The quantum computing device determines, based on the measurement on the first quantum register and the measurement on the third quantum register, that the test method passed or failed.', 'The application discloses a quantum data storage method, a quantum data reading device and a quantum data computing device, and relates to the field of quantum computers. The quantum data storage method includes: acting the first quantum neural network on the initial state to obtain an output quantum state; computing a loss function based on a target quantum state and a quantum state output by the first quantum neural network, wherein a dimension of the first quantum neural network is related to a dimension of the target quantum state, the loss function corresponding to a distance between the target quantum state and the quantum state output by the first quantum neural network; adjusting parameters of the first quantum neural network according to the loss function so as to carry out iterative training on the first quantum neural network until a preset iteration stop condition is reached; and storing the trained parameters of the first quantum neural network in hardware equipment. The storage of quantum data can be realized by utilizing the embodiment of the application.', 'The invention discloses a construction method, a device, a medium and an electronic device of a quantum discriminator, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining a first quantum logic gate for performing superposition operation on a quantum state of a single quantum bit, determining a second quantum logic gate for performing superposition operation on a quantum state of two quantum bits, determining a third quantum logic gate for performing entanglement operation on a quantum state of two quantum bits, and determining a fourth quantum logic gate for solving fidelity of two different quantum states; the quantum discriminator can be used for further constructing quantum GAN or quantum classical mixed GAN, so that the mathematical problem is effectively processed by utilizing the characteristic of quantum superposition, and the problems of large GAN calculation amount and convergence failure in the training process are solved.']

Name: 3_water_prediction_quality_data
Representative_Docs: ['The invention discloses a water quality and water ecology integrated early warning system, which comprises a meteorological forecasting model, a runoff and pollution load forecasting model, a water intake area water quality forecasting model, a water pipeline water quality forecasting model and a water receiving area water ecology change forecasting model, wherein a water quality and water ecology integrated early warning system is established through coupling, water quality variable parameters among different models are mutually converted, synchronous calibration of the parameters of the integrated forecasting system is carried out through a genetic algorithm, measured data is substituted in the forecasting process of each model, the simulation forecasting result is continuously corrected, the precision of the subsequent calculation result is further improved, a more accurate water quality and water ecology integrated early warning result is obtained, the water ecology change process of the water receiving area in the next several days can be forecasted through a rainfall driving system, and in order to timely prejudge the water environment and water ecology risks of the water receiving area, and aiming at various risks which may occur, an optimized scheduling scheme is formulated, and important technical support is provided for guaranteeing the water supply safety of drinking water.', 'The invention discloses a water environment water quality prediction and abnormal state tracing method and device, comprising the following steps: s1, acquiring water environment monitoring data; step S2, training a data-driven deep belief network model according to the water environment monitoring data; s3, predicting the water quality state in different time periods in the future by using the trained deep belief network model as a prediction model; and meanwhile, the tracing analysis of the abnormal state of the water quality of the water environment is realized through the sensitivity analysis of the prediction model. By adopting the technical scheme of the invention, the problems of low water environment water quality prediction precision and difficult backtracking of abnormal water quality states are solved.', 'The embodiment of the invention relates to an intelligent monitoring and analyzing method and system for water pollution. Wherein, the method comprises the following steps: acquiring water quality data of a monitored water area through a receiving module of the water area pollution monitoring and analyzing device; inputting water quality data into a water quality characteristic extraction model in a processing module through the processing module in the water area pollution monitoring and analyzing device to obtain the water quality characteristics of the monitored water area, wherein the water quality characteristic extraction model is trained in advance; determining a state diagram of a monitored water area according to the water quality characteristics through a coding module in the water area pollution monitoring and analyzing device; and sending the state diagram to a preset server through a routing module in the water pollution monitoring and analyzing device. The invention solves the technical problems of low data transmission speed and processing speed and poor safety caused by the separation of the data acquisition end and the data processing end in the water pollution monitoring and analyzing system.']

Name: 4_face_facial_image_recognition
Representative_Docs: ['The invention provides a face recognition method based on a monitoring video, which comprises the following steps: s1, collecting face detection training data and face matching training data; s2, constructing a face detection model and a face matching model; s3, respectively inputting the collected face detection training data and face matching training data into the constructed face detection model and face matching model for training; and S4, performing face recognition on the monitoring video by using the trained face detection model and the face matching model. The invention provides a face snapshot, model training and face recognition method, which can improve the face recognition precision in a monitoring scene and improve the actual combat application capability of a monitoring system.', 'The invention relates to an artificial intelligence technology, and discloses a face recognition method based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps: acquiring face image data from a webpage based on a crawler technology, forming an original face image set, extracting face features of the original face image set according to a Gabor filter to obtain a face feature set, performing dimension reduction processing on the face feature set according to a downsampling technology to form a face feature vector set, inputting the face feature vector set into a pre-built convolutional neural network model for training, exiting training until a loss function value in the convolutional neural network is smaller than a preset threshold value, receiving a user face picture, inputting the user face picture into the convolutional neural network for face recognition, and outputting a recognition result. The invention also provides a face recognition device based on deep learning and a computer readable storage medium. The invention can realize high-efficiency and accurate face recognition.', 'The application relates to a living body face recognition method and a system, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a face image set; establishing a plurality of parallel depth separable convolutional networks based on a MobilenetV2 network to obtain an initial face recognition model; performing iterative training on the initial face recognition model based on the face image set to obtain a target face recognition model with complete training; and acquiring a face image to be tested and inputting the face image to the target face recognition model to obtain a face recognition result. The method and the device can accurately and quickly identify the true and false conditions of the human face, and are beneficial to improving the safety of the human face identification technology.']

Name: 5_defect_detection_defects_image
Representative_Docs: ['The embodiment of the application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for detecting surface defects of an article, relates to the fields of artificial intelligent computer vision, deep learning and cloud computing, and particularly relates to an image recognition technology. The specific implementation scheme is as follows: inputting the surface image of the object to be detected into a defect detection model to identify and determine the defect type; the defect detection model is a deep learning model and comprises at least two layers of feature extraction networks; extracting intermediate image features output by at least one layer of feature extraction network in the identification process of the defect detection model; matching the intermediate image features with intermediate image features in a preset intermediate image feature library; and correcting the defect type determined by the defect detection model according to the matching result. According to the embodiment of the application, when the newly added defect types are identified, the defect detection model does not need to be updated, and the newly added defect types can be directly matched through the preset intermediate image feature library, so that the detection efficiency is further improved.', 'The embodiment of the application discloses a defect identification method, a defect identification device, a storage medium and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a target image, wherein the target image comprises a target detection object; determining a matching algorithm adapted to the target detection object in a preset algorithm library; and identifying the defect of the target detection object based on the matching algorithm to obtain a defect identification result aiming at the target detection object, wherein the defect identification result comprises defect position information, size information of the defect and defect type information corresponding to the defect position information. The method and the device can be used for identifying the defects of the target detection object in the target object based on various methods, and comprehensively processing data through the defect identification result obtained by various methods, so that the defect identification result aiming at the target detection object with accuracy obviously superior to that of the related technology is obtained.', 'The application relates to the field of defect detection, in particular to a target surface defect detection method, device, equipment and medium, and aims to solve the problem that the surface defect of a radioactive target cannot be detected by direct observation. The target surface defect detection method comprises the steps of obtaining a target surface defect image set, obtaining a training data set according to the target surface defect image set, training a detection network based on the training data set to obtain a detection model, inputting an image of a target to be detected into the detection model to obtain a detection result, and sending the detection result to a user terminal if the detection result is determined to be defective.']

Name: 6_voice_audio_sound_speech
Representative_Docs: ['The invention belongs to the technical field of voice enhancement of voice signal processing, and provides a voice enhancement method and a voice enhancement system for generating an countermeasure network based on multi-angle discrimination. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a noisy speech signal; based on the voice signal with noise, adopting a trained generation countermeasure network to obtain an enhanced voice signal; wherein the generating an countermeasure network includes a generator and four discriminators. The multi-angle discrimination of the present invention includes: the difference between the enhanced speech signal, clean speech and emotional speech; and meanwhile, the frequency domain difference among the enhanced voice signal, the clean voice and the emotion voice is judged and learned from the frequency domain. The invention judges the voice components of different voice signals and fully learns the voice components from different angles, provides enough feedback information for the generator, can effectively improve voice distortion and improve the voice quality of the enhanced voice.', 'The invention discloses a defense method of a StarGAN-based speech recognition model, which comprises the following steps: constructing a StarGAN model containing a generator, a discriminator and a classifier; constructing a loss function comprising an antagonistic loss function, a classification loss function and a cyclic consistent loss function; training the StarGAN model by taking the minimum training loss function as a target; in the voice recognition process, a trained classifier is used for classifying the original audio, and when the classification result is normal audio, the voice recognition model is directly used for carrying out voice recognition on the original audio to obtain a voice recognition result; and when the classification result is not the normal audio, generating a generated audio which accords with the given normal audio attribute for the original audio by using the generator, and performing voice recognition on the generated audio by using the voice recognition model to obtain a voice recognition result. The problem that a voice recognition model is easily attacked in an anti-attack mode is solved, and therefore recognition accuracy and robustness are improved.', 'The application provides a sound noise reduction method and device, an electronic device and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring voice audio information to be denoised, wherein the voice audio information consists of a plurality of time frames; inputting voice audio information into a sound event detection model to obtain sound event types under each time frame; determining whether to start a noise reduction model according to the sound event type and the target scene; and under the condition that the noise reduction model is determined to be started, inputting the voice audio information into the noise reduction model to carry out noise reduction processing and automatic gain control, and obtaining the voice audio information after noise reduction, wherein the automatic gain control is used for controlling the volume of the output voice audio. By the method and the device, the problems that sound events cannot be distinguished and all non-voice sounds can be eliminated in the related technology are solved.']

Name: 7_crop_pest_plant_disease
Representative_Docs: ['The invention belongs to the technical field of crop disease and pest identification, and provides a method and a device for identifying crop disease and pest based on deep learning, wherein S1, image data of crops in a target area are firstly acquired and preprocessed to obtain the target data, S2, environment data corresponding to the target data are obtained through matching, S3, standard input data are generated based on image historical data and corresponding environment data, an artificial intelligent model is trained through the standard input data and standard output data, and S4, the target data and the corresponding environment data are integrated into a disease and pest identification sequence.', 'The invention discloses a plant disease and pest detection method and system, and belongs to the field of forestry production. Aiming at the problems of poor precision and time consumption of the existing plant disease and insect pest detection, the invention provides a plant disease and insect pest detection method which comprises the steps of obtaining a visible light image of a plant in a nursery and three-dimensional depth information of the plant to obtain an RGB-D image, dividing the RGB-D image into a plurality of grids with equal size, preprocessing the grids, inputting the grids into a deep learning model for detection, and finally obtaining a plant disease and insect pest detection result. The detection method introduces three-dimensional depth information of the plants, is beneficial to more accurately judging the positions and the ranges of the plant diseases and insect pests, enhances the robustness of a deep learning model, is beneficial to accurately detecting the plant diseases and insect pests under the condition of poor illumination conditions, improves the detection accuracy and the detection efficiency, can realize real-time and automatic plant disease and insect pest detection in a field environment, and is suitable for large-scale popularization and use. The system has simple structure composition, and performs real-time processing and analysis while collecting data, thereby reducing the complexity of installation and maintenance and enhancing the real-time performance of the whole detection process.', 'A plant disease and insect pest identification method based on deep learning relates to the field of plant disease and insect pest prevention and control, and solves the problems of low image identification rate, complex model structure and low prediction accuracy of the existing crop disease and insect pest classification and identification method. The invention comprises the following steps: collecting plant disease and insect pest leaf images and normal plant leaf images; preprocessing the image to obtain a super-resolution plant disease and insect pest leaf target image; fusing, analyzing and calculating the super-resolution plant disease and insect pest leaf target image through a deep learning algorithm to generate plant disease and insect pest image characteristic expression; analyzing and calculating the characteristic expression of the plant disease and insect pest image through a deep learning network to generate a plant disease and insect pest identification model based on the deep learning network; and training the plant disease and insect pest leaf images needing to be identified by using a plant disease and insect pest identification model based on a deep learning network. The invention has high image recognition rate, simple model structure and high prediction accuracy.']

Name: 8_rock_geological_drilling_prediction
Representative_Docs: ['The invention relates to a stratum pressure coefficient prediction method in the field of oil and gas wells, in particular to a stratum pressure prediction method based on a machine learning improvement algorithm. The method comprises the following steps: step 1, collecting a exploratory well and a development well in a block from a drilled well Shi Ziliao according to drilling engineering and geological exploration requirements; step 2, preprocessing the collected data: data cleaning, namely removing abnormal values and null values of data, and counting data distribution; step 3, carrying out spearman correlation coefficient analysis on the logging data and the formation pressure to obtain proper LSTM training parameters; step 4, establishing a PSO-LSTM model, and performing neural network learning training by using the existing block logging data processed in the step 2; the beneficial effects are that: the model training time is saved, the efficiency is improved, the accuracy of stratum pressure prediction is improved, reference can be provided for safe drilling of drilling engineering, and the model training time has greater application potential in future artificial intelligence and petroleum engineering combined application.', 'The invention belongs to the technical field of soft rock tunnel deformation prediction, and provides a soft rock tunnel long-term deformation prediction method based on machine learning, which comprises the steps of acquiring surrounding rock deformation, surrounding rock stress and supporting structure stress data in the tunnel construction process as a model original database; preprocessing various data in an original database, classifying the various data according to the data change rate, establishing a transaction table, calculating and establishing a correlation rule, screening out a monitoring object with high correlation with tunnel surrounding rock deformation, establishing a sample database by the data of the object, and establishing a BP-neural network prediction model for training to obtain a prediction model meeting a target value condition. According to the invention, the correlation between each sample data and the target predicted value is established, the monitoring object most correlated with the target value is screened out, and the monitoring object data is used as the input of the prediction model, so that the prediction rate of the model can be accelerated, and the prediction precision of the model can be improved.', 'The invention provides an advanced geological prediction method and system based on while-drilling sensing, and relates to the technical field of advanced geological prediction, wherein the scheme comprises the steps of obtaining drilling parameters in a drilling process; acquiring a tunnel surrounding rock physical and mechanical parameter based on the drilling parameter inversion; obtaining rock slag or rock powder based on flushing fluid collected in the drilling process; acquiring geological characteristic parameters of rock slag or rock powder; and obtaining at least one of an unfavorable geological recognition result and a surrounding rock grading result by utilizing a pre-trained deep learning model according to the acquired tunnel surrounding rock physical and mechanical parameters and geological characteristic parameters, thereby realizing advanced geological prediction. The scheme combines advanced geological drilling, geological features are comprehensively reflected from two aspects of physical and mechanical property change and geological feature parameter change of tunnel surrounding rock, and advanced prediction of the front geology of the tunnel face is finally realized by collecting and analyzing drilling parameters and flushing fluid in the advanced drilling process and integrating big data and a depth learning algorithm.']

Name: 9_image_images_first_an
Representative_Docs: ['The invention discloses an image generation method and device, a storage medium and computer equipment, relates to the technical field of image processing and the field of medical services, and mainly aims to solve the problem of low image generation accuracy. The method mainly comprises the steps of obtaining a target text of an image to be generated, wherein the target text comprises an image category description text and a business object description text; matching a target image generation model from the trained image generation models of different service classes based on the image class description text; performing image generation processing on the target text by using a target image generation model to obtain a target image; the training process of the trained image generation model comprises the following steps: and constructing an initial image generation model, and training the initial image generation model based on the acquired knowledge graph and text image samples under different expected service categories to obtain trained image generation models of different service categories. The method is mainly used for generating the image.', 'The invention discloses an image generation method, a training method of an image generation model and electronic equipment. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a first image of a target object and a second image of a target element, extracting features of the second image by utilizing a first branch of an image generation model to obtain image features of the second image, denoising the first image by utilizing a second branch of the image generation model to obtain a processed first image, wherein the image generation model is obtained by training based on a first sample image of a sample object, a second sample image of the sample element and a target constraint, the target constraint is obtained by constructing based on the first sample image and a sample object posture image, the sample object posture image is used for representing the posture of the sample object in the first sample image, and fusing the second image and the processed first image based on the image features to obtain the target image. The invention solves the technical problem of poor image generation effect in the related technology.', 'The application discloses an image processing method, an image processing device, an image processing equipment, a storage medium and a storage product, which relate to the technical field of image processing, and the image processing method disclosed by the application comprises the following steps: when an image processing model receives an image to be processed, extracting first image features corresponding to the image to be processed under each preset frequency; inputting each first image feature into a gating recursive network module respectively to obtain each second image feature of the image to be processed; residual connection is carried out on each first image feature and the corresponding second image feature, so that each third image feature is obtained; and respectively carrying out up-sampling operation on each third image feature to obtain an image after the image to be processed is processed, and improving the image processing quality.']

Name: 10_machine_data_learning_model
Representative_Docs: ['According to an embodiment of the present invention, a method for classifying data by using a dual machine-learning model, which is created by using a first data set selected from data of a first type and second and third data sets selected from data of a second type separately, includes the following steps: (a) creating a first machine-learning model through learning in a first machine-learning mode using the first and second data sets separately as learning data; (b) creating a second machine-learning model through learning in a second machine-learning mode using the first data set and a fourth data set, which is a data set misclassified as a first type by the first machine-learning model from the third data set inputted into the first machine-learning model, separately as learning data; and (c) finally classifying classification target data as a first or second type by using the first and second machine-learning models.', 'One embodiment of a method for training a first machine learning model having a different architecture than a second machine learning model includes receiving a first data set, performing one or more operations to generate a second data set based on the first data set and the second machine learning model, wherein the second data set includes at least one feature associated with one or more tasks that the second machine learning model was previously trained to perform, and performing one or more operations to train the first machine learning model based on the second data set and the second machine learning model.', 'A method for developing machine operation classifiers for a machine is disclosed. The method includes receiving training data associated with the machine from one or more on-board engineering channels associated with the machine and determining one or more training features based on the training data values. The method also includes determining one or more training labels associated with the one or more training features and building a predictive model for determining machine operation classifiers using a computer. Building the predictive model may include feeding the one or more training features and the one or more training labels associated with the one or more training features to a machine learning algorithm and determining a predictive model from the machine learning algorithm. The predictive model may be used for receiving new data associated with the machine and determining a predicted label based on the new data.']

Name: 11_federal_privacy_learning_local
Representative_Docs: ['The invention discloses a differential privacy oriented federal learning privacy budget customizing method, which belongs to the technical field of federal learning and privacy protection and comprises the following steps of S1, initializing a global model by a server side to obtain an initial local model, running a DQN model by the server side, obtaining privacy budgets customized for each client side and distributing the privacy budgets to each client side, S2, local model training, S3, customizing differential privacy and adding noise, S4, uploading disturbance models, S5, global model aggregation, carrying out global model aggregation after the server side receives the disturbance models uploaded by the client side, S6, global model distribution and updating, and then repeating the steps until a proper model is obtained. The federal learning privacy budget customizing method for the differential privacy is adopted, so that the precision of a federal learning model is improved while the privacy safety is ensured.', 'The application provides a data processing method, a data processing device, data processing equipment and a data processing storage medium based on federal learning, relates to the technical field of machine learning, and aims to solve the problem of poor system performance in the process of training a federal model; the method comprises the following steps: at least one client learns the data characteristics of local data through a local sample generator, obtains a training sample generator and sends the training sample generator to a server; the server carries out federal aggregation on the training sample generator sent by at least one client to obtain a federal sample generator and sends the federal sample generator to at least one client; at least one client generates first virtual data consistent with data characteristics of local data of other clients through a federal sample generator, and determines the local data of the client and the first virtual data as target data. According to the method, the data calculation amount of the federal model is reduced, the system resources consumed by the federal model are reduced, the system performance during the federal model training is improved, and the training efficiency of the federal model is improved.', 'The application discloses a federal learning method, a federal learning system, federal learning equipment and a federal learning storage medium. The method is applied to a federal learning system; the federal learning system comprises a server and a plurality of clients, wherein each client in the plurality of clients comprises a plurality of models, and the plurality of clients comprise a first client; the method comprises the following steps: the first client divides the first data set into a plurality of data subsets; the first client trains a plurality of models based on a plurality of data subsets to obtain model training information; the server receives a plurality of model training information; the server side aggregates the model parameters which are associated with the same identifier in the plurality of model training information to obtain a plurality of first parameter aggregation results; the server side aggregates the plurality of first parameter aggregation results to obtain a second parameter aggregation result, and sends the second parameter aggregation result to each client side. Therefore, the model can be retrained by adopting a smaller sample size after the data is desensitized, so that the training scale is reduced, the training time is shortened, and the training cost is reduced.']

Name: 12_text_word_language_document
Representative_Docs: ['The application discloses a text classification method and device, and relates to the technical field of text processing. The specific implementation scheme is as follows: acquiring a text to be classified; inputting the text into a preset long text recognition model to obtain a vector sequence corresponding to the text; the long text recognition model includes: vectorization models and dynamic self-attention models; inputting a vector sequence corresponding to the text into a preset vector splicing model to obtain a vector corresponding to the text; the vector corresponding to the text is input into a preset classification model, and a classification result corresponding to the text is obtained, so that long text exceeding the preset word number can be classified, the loss of text information is avoided, and the accuracy of text classification is improved.', 'The application discloses a text processing method, a text processing device, a text processing apparatus, a storage medium and a computer program product, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a text to be processed; and inputting the text to be processed into the target text classification model for processing to obtain a text classification result of the text to be processed. The target text classification model is obtained by performing model training by using a plurality of text sets, and each text set comprises a first text and a second text which is a synonymous text with the first text; the target text classification model is obtained by adjusting model parameters of the initial text classification model based on the classification loss parameters and the matching loss parameters; the classification loss parameter is determined based on a first text feature obtained by processing a first text by an initial text classification model; the matching loss parameter is determined based on the first text feature and a second text feature obtained by processing a second text through the initial text classification model. Through the text classification method and device, the accuracy of text classification can be effectively improved.', 'The application relates to the technical field of natural language processing, and provides a text semantic recognition method, a text semantic recognition device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: calculating word vectors of text characters in the target text and word vectors of each text word; splicing the word vector of each text character with the word vector of the text participle to obtain a spliced vector of the text character; sequentially inputting the word vectors and the splicing vectors of the text characters into a first neural network according to the forward appearance sequence of the text characters in the target text to obtain first text characteristics; according to the reverse appearance sequence of the text characters in the target text, sequentially inputting the word vectors and the splicing vectors corresponding to the text characters into a second neural network to obtain second text characteristics; and inputting the comprehensive text features obtained by splicing the first text features and the second text features into a third neural network to obtain the semantic type of the target text. By adopting the method, the accuracy of text semantic recognition is improved.']

Name: 13_vehicle_driving_driver_the
Representative_Docs: ['The present teaching relates to method, system, medium, and implementation of human-like vehicle control for an autonomous vehicle. Information related to a target motion to be achieved by the autonomous vehicle is received, wherein the information includes a current vehicle state of the autonomous vehicle. A first vehicle control signal is generated with respect to the target motion and the given vehicle state in accordance with a vehicle kinematic model. A second vehicle control signal is generated in accordance with a human-like vehicle control model, with respect to the target motion, the given vehicle state, and the first vehicle control signal, wherein the second vehicle control signal modifies the first vehicle control signal to achieve human-like vehicle control behavior.', 'The application discloses a method for planning a vehicle driving route, which can be applied to an intelligent automobile and an intelligent networking automobile and comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining first information, wherein the first information comprises one or more of position information, lane information, navigation information and obstacle information of a vehicle. When the vehicle is in the automatic driving mode, the first information is input data of a first model, output data of the first model is used for planning a driving route for the vehicle, the first model is a model obtained by training second information acquired in the manual driving mode by taking a driving track of the vehicle in the manual driving mode as a training target, the type of the information included in the second information is consistent with the type of the information included in the first information, and the similarity between the first information and the second information meets a preset condition. The first information is used to train a first model when the vehicle is in a manual driving mode. According to the scheme provided by the application, the receiving rate of the driver can be reduced for a large number of long-tail scenes.', 'Disclosed is a method for predicting a vehicle entering a driving path of a vehicle of a user or a vehicle escaping the driving path of the vehicle of a user through machine learning, and controlling the vehicle. A method for predicting a driving path of a surrounding vehicle includes the steps of: obtaining data on a vehicle of a user and a surrounding vehicle; learning a driving path of the surrounding vehicle on the driving direction of the vehicle of the user, a position and the speed of the vehicle of the user and the surrounding vehicle by using the data; and predicting a driving path of the surrounding vehicle by using the learning result and the data.']

Name: 14_security_attack_malicious_network
Representative_Docs: ['The invention relates to a network security management system based on big data, which comprises a recognition module, a first analysis module, a second analysis module and a management module, wherein the recognition module is used for inputting the extracted feature vector into a preset recognition algorithm to carry out threat information recognition to obtain a threat information recognition result, the first analysis module is used for carrying out network attack behavior analysis on network collected data based on the threat information recognition result to obtain an attack scene if the threat information recognition result has network abnormal behavior, the attack scene comprises an attack chain and an attack mode, the second analysis module is used for carrying out association analysis on the network collected data based on the attack scene to obtain a threat factor of network security, and the management module is used for setting a corresponding security management strategy based on the threat factor of network security.', 'The invention discloses a method for detecting network security data information, which comprises the following steps: obtaining a network security data sample and a malicious data sample through historical network data; acquiring network data information to be detected, and storing the acquired network data information to be detected into a data queue; processing the network data information to be detected, and extracting characteristics of the network data information; and matching the obtained network data information characteristics with the network security data sample and the malicious data sample, and judging that the network data information is security data if the network data information characteristics are successfully matched with the network security data sample. The method judges the network data to be detected through the machine learning model, has high processing speed, can filter out most invalid data in advance, can improve the judging efficiency, can actively discover malicious network data and limit the source of the malicious data.', 'The invention provides a network security attack type and threat level prediction method based on machine learning, which comprises the steps of firstly collecting historical network traffic data, classifying and preprocessing the network traffic data according to the attack type and the security threat level, constructing a training set and a testing set, establishing a corresponding prediction model for each preset machine learning algorithm, adopting each machine learning algorithm to train the corresponding prediction model according to the training set, obtaining the prediction accuracy of each machine learning algorithm, selecting the prediction model corresponding to the machine learning algorithm with the highest prediction accuracy, collecting new network traffic data, and finally obtaining the prediction results of the attack type and the threat level by using the selected prediction model and the new network traffic data. The invention can further refine the problem of abnormal prediction of network security, predict attack types and threat levels, improve the efficiency of abnormal processing of network security and further guarantee the network security.']

Name: 15_ship_underwater_sar_fish
Representative_Docs: ['The invention relates to a SAR (synthetic aperture radar) ship rotating target detection method which comprises the steps of obtaining ship data of an SAR image to be detected, inputting the ship data of the SAR image to be detected into a trained rotating target detection model to infer angle, position and category information of a ship target, constructing the rotating target detection model based on YOLOv networks of a convolution block attention mechanism and a midpoint offset representation method of a rotating rectangular frame, constructing the trained rotating target detection model based on a pre-constructed training set and adopting a multi-task joint network loss function suitable for rotating detection to train the rotating target detection model, and constructing the pre-constructed training set based on ship sample data of an original SAR image and a label file marked with the rotating rectangular frame where the ship target to be detected is located. The method can avoid losing boundary discontinuity, has the advantage of small lightweight network parameters, can realize detection of SAR image ship targets in any direction, and can obtain corresponding angle information of the ship.', 'The invention discloses a ship tracking and character recognition optimizing method and system, which relate to the field of artificial intelligence, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining a target monitoring video of a target sea area, and dividing the target monitoring video into a plurality of video segments through a detection model; extracting target image frames in a target video clip; obtaining target ship characteristics of a target ship and storing the target ship characteristics into a tracking model; tracking the model to obtain a real-time track of the target; the track prediction model obtains real-time track prediction; tracking and collecting to obtain target ship tracking information; and analyzing the character recognition model to obtain the target ship board number. The problem that the existing ship tracking based on the target detection algorithm has the conditions of missing detection and false detection, and template matching tracking has template drift is solved. The target ship tracking information is obtained by tracking the target ship in real time, so that the comprehensive and accurate tracking of the ship target is realized, the effective tracking information is provided for the identification of the ship side number of the ship, and the effect of improving the ship side number identification efficiency and accuracy is achieved.', 'The invention discloses a SAR image ship target detection method, device, equipment and medium, and belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The SAR image detection method based on the slicing assisted super reasoning comprises the steps of dividing an SAR image into a plurality of sub-images, respectively inputting the sub-images into a target detection model, obtaining ship target detection results in each sub-image, wherein the target detection model is a convolutional neural network model trained in advance, and combining the ship target detection results of the sub-images to obtain the ship target detection results in the SAR image. According to the ship target detection method, a C2f module of a YOLOv n backbone network is improved by introducing dynamic serpentine convolution, the asymptotic characteristic pyramid network is used for fusing the characteristics of different depths output by the backbone network, and ShapeIOU is used as a loss function, so that the detection capability of a target detection model on targets with different scales, shapes and postures is enhanced, and the accuracy and the robustness of small and medium ship target detection in SAR images are improved.']

Name: 16_question_answer_query_search
Representative_Docs: ['The present disclosure provides a question-answering method, apparatus, device, medium, and program product, which can be applied to the technical fields of artificial intelligence, big data, computer, and finance. The question answering method comprises the following steps: responding to the received question-answer request, and acquiring the question content of the question-answer request; analyzing the problem content to obtain a problem knowledge domain label, a plurality of problem entities and a problem entity relation, wherein the problem entity relation is used for representing the association relation among the plurality of problem entities; extracting an answer relation subgraph from a preset knowledge graph according to the question knowledge domain labels and the question entities, wherein the preset knowledge graph comprises knowledge domain label nodes corresponding to the question domain and answer entity nodes associated with the question entities; and obtaining a reference answer of the question-answer request according to the question entity, the question entity relationship and the answer relationship subgraph.', 'The application discloses a question and answer method, a question and answer device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, which belong to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and the method comprises the following steps: carrying out semantic analysis on the acquired context of the question to obtain a semantic vector of the question, merging background knowledge of the question into the semantic vector to obtain a knowledge vector of the question, carrying out attention analysis based on the semantic vector of the question and the semantic vector of each candidate answer to obtain semantic attention vectors of the question and the candidate answers, carrying out attention analysis based on the knowledge vector of the question and the knowledge vector of the candidate answer to obtain knowledge attention vectors of the question and the candidate answer, and then determining whether the candidate answer is a final answer of the question based on the semantic attention vectors of the question and the candidate answer and the knowledge attention vectors of the question and the candidate answer. Thus, the understanding of the questions is more comprehensive and accurate, and the answer accuracy is higher.', 'The application discloses an intelligent question-answering method, device, equipment and medium, and relates to the technical field of intelligent question-answering. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a user question containing multi-mode data and a candidate answer set corresponding to the user question, determining initial candidate answers according to semantic similarity between the user question and the candidate answer set, obtaining historical dialogue information in the interaction process with a user, conducting context analysis through a sliding window to generate an intention prediction result aiming at the user question, generating a new question sequence similar to the user question by utilizing a semantic generation model according to the intention prediction result, constructing an extended question-answer library based on the new question sequence, obtaining user feedback data, generating a question-answer result optimized for the initial candidate answers through a closed-loop optimization model based on the user feedback data and data in the extended question-answer library, and pushing the question-answer result to the user. By the technical scheme, the accuracy of question-answer matching can be greatly improved, and the user query experience is optimized.']

Name: 17_medical_patient_disease_health
Representative_Docs: ['The invention relates to the technical field of medical information, in particular to a medical data joint analysis system driven by a medical knowledge graph. The system comprises a medical knowledge graph construction module, a medical data quality evaluation module, a medical characteristic engineering module and a medical knowledge driving analysis module, wherein heterogeneous knowledge graph modeling can be carried out through integrating medical clinical guidelines, biomedical documents, a medicine database and historical medical data to generate a medical heterogeneous knowledge graph, new medical clinical test information is acquired, delayed contradiction learning updating is carried out to generate a medical dynamic updating knowledge graph, quality check evaluation and medical characteristic engineering analysis are carried out through acquiring multi-mode medical data, meanwhile, knowledge path joint driving analysis is carried out to generate a decision support reasoning path corresponding to medical clinical knowledge, and corresponding medical knowledge path confidence coefficient is output. The invention can realize the fusion reasoning among the cross-source data by constructing the multi-mode medical knowledge graph.', 'The present disclosure provides a medical data processing method and apparatus. The medical data processing method comprises the following steps: acquiring medical information of a user; acquiring medical condition data of a user according to the medical information; and determining the medical scheme with the highest effect value corresponding to the medical condition data according to the data processing classifier. The medical data processing method provided by the disclosure can obtain the medical scheme with better curative effect according to the data processing classifier provided by the disclosure, and provide the medical scheme for medical staff for reference, so that uncertainty caused by the fact that relevant medical staff determine the medical scheme is avoided, and rationality and accuracy of medical scheme setting are improved.', 'The invention provides a big data analysis medical decision method and a system, which relate to the technical field of intelligent medical treatment, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring medical data of a diagnostic target; classifying the medical data to obtain medical fields corresponding to the medical data; acquiring a knowledge graph and a clinical rule corresponding to the medical field; performing feature extraction on the medical data to obtain a plurality of data features of the medical data; screening according to the data characteristics by a characteristic selection technology to obtain related characteristics of the diagnosis target; performing rule matching on related features according to the knowledge graph and clinical rules to obtain explanatory data; obtaining the change trend of the related features in a preset future time period according to the related features; and determining an auxiliary medical decision strategy of the diagnosis target according to the change trend. The invention utilizes the interpretation data generated by the clinical rules and the knowledge graph to more clearly explain the medical decision basis of the diagnosis target and improve the interpretation capability of the auxiliary medical decision strategy.']

Name: 18_unmanned_path_aerial_vehicle
Representative_Docs: ['The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle flight path prediction method based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps: step one, abstracting a route planning scene into a multidimensional matrix by adopting a mode of simulating image pixel points; step two, inputting a deep neural network for training to obtain a group of weight matrixes with the same scale as path selection; setting a neural network parameter adjusting control strategy; and step four, expressing the weight matrix as a complete route by utilizing a path smoothing process. The method can help the unmanned aerial vehicle to predict the path at the next moment under the completely unknown environment, further guide the unmanned aerial vehicle to navigate and avoid the obstacle, and finally reach the target point safely. According to the invention, the external environment information of the unmanned aerial vehicle can be obtained in real time through online learning, and what action is performed by the unmanned aerial vehicle under what environment is learned. According to the invention, the unmanned aerial vehicle can completely realize navigation and obstacle avoidance under the unknown complex obstacle environment, and the limitation and complexity of real-time calculation of the original route planning algorithm are broken through.', 'The application relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, and particularly provides a method, a device, a storage medium and electronic equipment for predicting a track of an unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the method can comprise the steps of obtaining unmanned aerial vehicle data of a target unmanned aerial vehicle; the unmanned aerial vehicle target system comprises a target unmanned aerial vehicle, unmanned aerial vehicle data, environment data, processing the unmanned aerial vehicle data and acquiring processed data, wherein the processed data comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle track vector matrix and a time interval vector, and the processed data is analyzed by at least one of a pre-trained unmanned aerial vehicle track prediction module and an adjustment module to acquire a future track prediction result of the target unmanned aerial vehicle when the target unmanned aerial vehicle is of a cooperative unmanned aerial vehicle type and the unmanned aerial vehicle data is of a non-cooperative unmanned aerial vehicle type. The embodiment of the application can realize track prediction of different unmanned aerial vehicles, and has better universality.', 'The invention discloses a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle logistics distribution path planning method, a device, a system and a storage medium, which comprise the steps of S1, constructing an unmanned aerial vehicle low-altitude logistics path planning data set, S2, carrying out heterogeneous graph modeling according to the unmanned aerial vehicle low-altitude logistics path planning data set, wherein one heterogeneous graph comprises a flight area, an unmanned aerial vehicle, a task and environment information, S3, constructing a heterogeneous graph rolling network according to the heterogeneous graph, and S4, carrying out multi-unmanned aerial vehicle logistics distribution path optimization and decision-making based on the heterogeneous graph neural network. By adopting the technical scheme of the invention, the problems of data isomerism modeling deficiency, insufficient dynamic response, weak multi-objective optimization capability and the like in the traditional technology are solved.']

Name: 19_dialogue_user_conversation_customer
Representative_Docs: ['The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence dialogue text generation, in particular to a dialogue data sample enhancement method and a dialogue text generation model pre-training system, wherein single-round dialogue is selected from a collected dialogue sample data set, the single-round dialogue comprises dialogue content, dialogue response and dialogue optimal knowledge, and the dialogue optimal knowledge is external knowledge which has optimal correlation degree of single-round dialogue subjects and assists in generating dialogue response; and splicing the original single-round dialogue and the new extended single-round dialogue to obtain a dialogue sample data set after data enhancement. The invention can strengthen the utilization of the prior knowledge dialogue data, realize data enhancement by a simple method under the condition of not increasing the data marking cost, improve the model performance and enable the model to obtain the capability of generating replies under different visual angles in the training process.', 'The application discloses a dialogue generation model training method, which comprises the following steps: a dialogue data set is obtained, wherein the dialogue data in the dialogue data set comprises a question sentence and a labeling reply corresponding to the question sentence; based on the question in the dialogue data set, obtaining a coding representation of the question through an encoder in a constructed dialogue generation model, and obtaining a prediction reply corresponding to the question output by the dialogue generation model by fusing the coding representation of the question and knowledge information of transfer learning of the question from a knowledge base question-answer model through a decoder in the dialogue generation model; and determining a loss function based on the prediction reply and the annotation reply corresponding to the question, and adjusting parameters of the dialogue generating model through the loss function until the loss function of the dialogue generating model is converged. The method enables the model to better integrate knowledge information, thereby improving the accuracy and rationality of dialogue generation. The application also discloses a dialogue generation method, a device, equipment and a medium.', 'The invention discloses a dialogue model construction method based on deep learning, wherein the model is a dialogue action coding model, the dialogue history coding model, the dialogue action prediction model and the dialogue reply generation model. The dialogue action coding model and the dialogue history coding model are used for coding a history dialogue action sequence and a dialogue history; the dialog action prediction model is used to predict the dialog action of the next round, and finally the dialog reply generation model is used to generate a reply. The dialogue model improves the accuracy of generating replies by predicting historical dialogue actions and next round of dialogue actions, and can avoid generating repeated redundant information by encoding dialogue histories, thereby effectively accelerating the efficiency of the task type dialogue system in practical application and improving user experience.']

Name: 20_neural_convolution_network_operation
Representative_Docs: ['A convolution operation device includes a convolution calculation module, a memory and a buffer device. The convolution calculation module has a plurality of convolution units, and each convolution unit performs a convolution operation according to a filter and a plurality of current data, and leaves a part of the current data after the convolution operation. The buffer device is coupled to the memory and the convolution calculation module for retrieving a plurality of new data from the memory and inputting the new data to each of the convolution units. The new data are not a duplicate of the current data. A convolution operation method is also disclosed.', 'The embodiment of the invention discloses a method, a device and a system for processing data, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring input data; obtaining convolution operation characteristics of a first convolution layer, wherein the first convolution layer is any convolution layer in a neural network model, the neural network model comprises at least one convolution layer, and the convolution operation characteristics comprise at least one parameter of the following parameters: the size of the convolution kernel, the moving steps of the convolution kernel, the number of input channels and the parallel granularity of the processor; acquiring a plurality of data blocks with the same number as the parallel granularity of the processor from the input data according to the convolution operation characteristic, wherein each data block in the plurality of data blocks is used for carrying out convolution processing with a convolution kernel; the plurality of data blocks are subjected to convolution processing in parallel to acquire output data. The method, the device and the system can adaptively select the optimal parallel operation according to the convolution operation characteristics of different convolution layers, thereby improving the parallelism of convolution operation.', 'The application relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence and provides a neural network accelerator. The neural network accelerator is simplified and designed by taking layers as basic units, each module can run in parallel to realize that each layer of the neural network can run on hardware simultaneously so as to greatly improve the processing speed, the main control module can complete the cutting distribution of each layer of operation tasks and corresponding data, and each module executes the operation tasks of the corresponding layer. And the neural network accelerator architecture also realizes a three-dimensional product accumulation array, so that multiplication and accumulation operations can be run in a large-scale parallel manner, the convolution calculation efficiency is effectively improved, data multiplexing and high-efficiency circulation of convolution operation parameters and convolution operation data among modules are realized through the first buffer area and the second buffer area, data multiplexing among layers of the neural network is realized to reduce external data access, the data processing efficiency is improved, the power consumption is reduced, and the calculation power consumption ratio of the neural network accelerator can be improved.']

Name: 21_video_frame_frames_the
Representative_Docs: ['The invention discloses a video classification method and device, a storage medium and electronic equipment related to artificial intelligence and a cloud server. The method comprises the steps of obtaining image characteristics of each frame of video frame in target video under the condition that the target video to be classified is obtained, carrying out clustering processing on all video frames in the target video according to characteristic distances among the image characteristics of each video frame to obtain a plurality of video clips, obtaining clip time sequence fusion characteristics corresponding to each video clip in the plurality of video clips, determining the video characteristics of the target video according to the clip time sequence fusion characteristics corresponding to each video clip, and identifying the video characteristics to obtain the target type of the target video. The invention solves the technical problem of inaccurate video classification.', 'The application discloses an information processing method, which is applied to the field of artificial intelligence and comprises the following steps: acquiring a video to be processed; sampling a video to be processed according to a time characteristic sampling rule, and acquiring at least one video frame characteristic sequence; processing at least one video frame feature sequence through a first neural network model to obtain a feature expression result of each video frame feature sequence; and processing the feature expression result of the at least one video frame feature sequence through the second neural network model to obtain a prediction result corresponding to the at least one video frame feature sequence, wherein the prediction result is used for determining the category of the video to be processed. The application also provides a server. The video classification method and the video classification device have the advantages that in the process of classifying videos, the characteristic change of the videos in the time dimension is considered, so that the video content can be better expressed, the video classification accuracy is improved, and the video classification effect is improved.', 'The embodiment of the application discloses a video frame detection method and device. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a target video frame sequence; extracting video feature data of the target video frame sequence by using a convolutional neural network model, wherein the convolutional neural network model is set to be obtained by learning according to a plurality of reference historical video frame sequences; carrying out video reconstruction according to the video characteristic data to generate a reconstructed video frame sequence; determining that an exception event exists in the sequence of target video frames based on a difference value between the sequence of target video frames and the sequence of reconstructed video frames. By the aid of the method and the device, detection accuracy and detection efficiency of video frame detection can be improved.']

Name: 22_character_text_recognition_image
Representative_Docs: ['The present disclosure relates to a character recognition method and apparatus, an electronic device, and a storage medium, wherein the method includes: acquiring a target image to be identified; obtaining character features of the target image based on the determined position vector and the first image features of the target image; wherein the position vector is determined based on the position characteristics of the characters in the preset information sequence; and identifying characters in the target image based on the character features to obtain a character identification result of the target image. The embodiment of the disclosure can improve the accuracy of character recognition.', 'The invention relates to artificial intelligence, and provides a hybrid convolution text-based image recognition method, a device, computer equipment and a storage medium, wherein an image to be recognized is obtained; acquiring a character image recognition model containing a mixed convolution kernel; inputting the image to be identified into a character image identification model to obtain a convolution feature diagram corresponding to the image to be identified; inputting the convolution feature map into a cyclic neural network of a character image recognition model to perform feature extraction to obtain sequence features; inputting the sequence features into a full-connection layer of a character image recognition model to obtain a character probability distribution result; and carrying out error loss calculation on the character probability distribution result by adopting a preset loss function to obtain a character recognition result of the image to be recognized. The mixed convolution kernel is adopted in the character image recognition model to carry out convolution feature extraction, so that the character recognition accuracy is improved. And the adjacent character areas are fully learned by adopting a mixed convolution kernel mode, so that the accuracy and coverage rate of character recognition are improved.', 'The disclosure provides a model training and character recognition method, device, equipment and storage medium, relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, in particular to the technical field of computer vision and deep learning, and can be applied to scenes such as OCR optical character recognition.
