The specific implementation scheme is as follows: obtaining a scene image, a second actual character in the scene image and a second construction image; performing character recognition on the scene image by adopting the model to be trained to obtain first characteristics and first recognition characters of the characters extracted in the character recognition process; performing character recognition on the second constructed image by adopting the auxiliary training model to obtain second characteristics of the characters extracted in the character recognition process; and adjusting the model parameters of the model to be trained based on the first recognition character, the second actual character, the first feature and the second feature to obtain a character recognition model. By applying the scheme provided by the embodiment of the disclosure, the model for character recognition can be trained.']

Name: 23_detection_target_object_image
Representative_Docs: ['The invention provides a small target detection method and a system based on scale sensitive loss and feature fusion, wherein the detection method comprises the following steps: establishing a training data set and a target detection network with scale sensitive loss and characteristic fusion; the data set comprises a plurality of training images, and each image is provided with at least one target to be detected; the detection model comprises a feature extraction module, a feature fusion module and a target detection module; training the detection model by adopting the training data set to obtain a trained detection model; the loss function adopted in the training process is the target offset loss caused by classification loss part, regression loss and down sampling; and inputting the image to be detected into the trained detection model to obtain a small target detection result. The technical scheme provided by the invention can solve the problems of complex network structure and low detection speed in small target detection.', 'The invention is applicable to the technical field of target detection, and provides a target detection method, a network, a device, terminal equipment and a storage medium, wherein a plurality of images are subjected to feature extraction to obtain a plurality of feature images with different dimensions corresponding to each image; splicing a plurality of feature images with different dimensions corresponding to each image to obtain a target feature image corresponding to each image; determining grids corresponding to each target feature map according to the area occupation ratio of the targets in each target feature map; according to grids corresponding to each target feature map, carrying out target prediction on each target feature map to obtain a target prediction result; calculating the loss of the target detection network according to the target prediction result, and carrying out optimization training on the target detection network according to the loss until the loss converges; the target detection network after the optimization training is completed to carry out target detection on the image to be detected, so that a target detection result is obtained, and the identification degree and the robustness of the characteristics during the detection of the small target can be improved.', 'The invention provides a detection method and a detection system for multiple target images, which relate to the technical field of image detection, and are characterized in that an original image data set is obtained, each original image in the original image data set comprises a large target area and a small target area, a target detection model is constructed, the target detection model comprises a YOLO network model, a FPN network model, a PAN network model and a detection network model which are connected in sequence, the method comprises the steps of training a target detection model through a preprocessed original image data set to obtain a trained target detection model, obtaining an image to be detected, inputting the image to be detected into the trained target detection model, outputting detection results of each target area of the image to be detected, and improving the positioning precision of a small target and the characteristic extraction effect of the small target.']

Name: 24_protein_drug_medicine_molecular
Representative_Docs: ['The invention discloses a drug molecule validity verification method and a drug molecule validity verification system based on a deep learning prediction model, wherein a drug molecule SMILES expression needing validity verification is input first; selecting a drug molecular attribute category to be predicted, and selecting a drug set to be subjected to interaction verification; then obtaining the structural information of the drug molecules from the SMILES expression, and generating an edge set of chemical bonds in the drug molecules according to the connection information between atoms; the final required atomic feature vector is obtained through normalization operation of the effective codes, and the atomic feature vector is integrated to obtain a medicine molecular feature matrix; and finally, judging the effectiveness of the drug molecules by carrying out attribute prediction on the drug molecules and carrying out interaction prediction on the common drug molecules based on the drug molecule attribute prediction model of the self-attention encoder and the drug interaction prediction model embedded at the edge. The invention is beneficial to improving the curative effect and safety of the medicine and improving the life quality of people.', 'The application discloses a method, a device and equipment for predicting the property of a small drug molecule based on a graph neural network, relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and can solve the technical problems of low efficiency and low accuracy of the existing prediction of the property of the small drug molecule. The method comprises the following steps: generating a molecular diagram structure according to the chemical molecular structure of the target drug small molecule, and generating a molecular subgraph structure according to the functional group intermediate structure of the target drug small molecule; determining a first characteristic vector corresponding to the molecular diagram structure and a second characteristic vector corresponding to the molecular subgraph structure by using a target diagram neural network model; and constructing a third feature vector according to the first feature vector and the second feature vector, and inputting the third feature vector into a property prediction model which is trained, so as to obtain a property prediction result of the target drug small molecule. The method is suitable for realizing intelligent prediction of the properties of small molecules of the medicine based on artificial intelligence technology.', 'The invention discloses an information pushing method and device based on medicine molecular image classification, relates to the technical field of intelligent medical treatment, and mainly aims to solve the problem that the existing information pushing efficiency based on medicine molecular structures is low. Comprising the following steps: acquiring medicine molecular structure image data of a target medicine; classifying the medical molecular structure image data based on the trained image classification model to obtain a medical molecular classification result; analyzing the drug characteristic information of the drug molecular classification result based on the drug molecular characteristic distribution sequence, and matching the drug characteristic information with the condition characteristic information of the target condition based on the drug characteristic information; and if the drug characteristic information is matched with the condition characteristic information of the target condition, outputting drug characteristic combination information and drug characteristic risk information matched with the drug characteristic information. The method is mainly used for information pushing based on medicine molecular image classification.']

Name: 25_vehicle_road_lane_detection
Representative_Docs: ['The invention discloses a complex road lane identification method and a chip based on deep learning, which relate to the technical field of computer vision and machine learning and comprise the following steps: establishing a lane data set for training a neural network model; establishing a YOLO neural network model, wherein the model comprises an input layer, a feature extraction network and a prediction network; training the neural network model in the step S2 by using the data set established in the step S1; collecting real-time image data of a driving lane, preprocessing the collected real-time image data of the driving lane, and generating a format image; and (4) inputting the format image into the neural network model trained in the step (S3), detecting the lane line, and outputting a detection result. The invention utilizes the improved YOLO neural network to train and detect the lane lines of the complex road surface, and can effectively improve the accuracy and speed of detecting the lane lines of the complex road surface.', 'The present disclosure relates to a lane line rectification method, apparatus, electronic device, storage medium, and program product. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a road image corresponding to a road where a vehicle is located; performing lane recognition on the road image, and determining the type of a lane where the vehicle is located; and correcting the lane line of the lane according to the type of the lane.', 'The invention provides a lane monitoring method, a lane monitoring device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a road image of a position where a vehicle is located and vehicle positioning information; acquiring road parameters corresponding to the vehicle through vehicle positioning information; determining a first vision processing result corresponding to the road image; filtering a first vision processing result corresponding to the road image, and determining a second vision processing result corresponding to the road image; determining lane information corresponding to the position of the vehicle through fusion processing of a second vision processing result and road parameters; monitoring the switching of the vehicle in different lanes based on lane information corresponding to the position of the vehicle; therefore, lane-level positioning of the vehicle is realized, and switching of the vehicle in different lanes is accurately monitored. The fields in which the solution can be applied include, but are not limited to, the fields of automatic driving, car networking, intelligent transportation, and the like.']

Name: 26_optimization_algorithm_population_optimal
Representative_Docs: ['The application relates to a production scheduling method and a device based on an improved genetic algorithm, wherein the production scheduling method comprises the following steps: initializing a population; the population comprises a plurality of individuals, and each individual in the plurality of individuals is obtained by classifying the order according to the grade of the raw material and/or the color of the raw material; calculating a fitness value of each individual; selecting individuals with high fitness from the population to enter a next generation population by using a roulette selection method; performing cross operation and mutation operation on the next generation of population; judging whether a stop condition is met; if the stopping condition is not met, returning to the step of population initialization, and if the stopping condition is met, outputting a scheduling scheme. By means of the technical scheme, the method and the device can reduce errors caused by manual production scheduling and improve production efficiency, and can also achieve automatic production scheduling of large-scale orders, so that the method and the device are more in line with actual production environment.', 'The invention relates to a robot inverse kinematics solving method based on a particle swarm optimization algorithm, which comprises the following steps of: 1) establishing a kinematics model according to joint parameters of the robot to obtain a kinematics forward solution formula, setting a position and posture matrix of a target point, and determining a fitness function; 2) initializing a particle population, and calculating individual fitness values of the initial population to obtain an individual optimal value and a global optimal value; 3) updating the position and the speed of the particle population by using the dynamic inertia weight which changes along with the iteration times, calculating a new fitness value, and judging whether to update; 4) carrying out genetic variation operation on the particle population, and calculating a fitness value; 5) and judging whether the termination condition is met according to the fitness value and the iteration times. Compared with the prior art, the method overcomes the defect that the traditional PSO algorithm is easy to fall into a local optimal value, and can improve the speed and the precision of convergence by reducing the iteration times and enhancing the local search capability.', 'The invention relates to a flexible job shop scheduling method for solving moving time by improving a genetic algorithm, which effectively solves the problem that the moving time is neglected by the existing algorithm, and the processing quality of products is possibly influenced in some specific production fields; the technical scheme for solving the problem is that the method comprises the steps of firstly, setting parameters; initializing a population, and randomly generating population individuals by using a random selection method; step three, calculating and evaluating the fitness value of each chromosome in the population and comparing the fitness values, if the fitness value meets the condition or is close to the optimal solution, finishing, and if not, executing the step four; selecting by a championship selection method, and selecting a next generation population; fifthly, carrying out chromosome individuals satisfying the cross probability in the population; compiling chromosome individuals meeting the variation probability to obtain a new population; step seven, returning to the step three; the invention realizes the quick optimization of the scheduling scheme.']

Name: 27_segmentation_image_semantic_fusion
Representative_Docs: ['The application discloses an image semantic segmentation method, which is applied to electronic equipment comprising an image semantic segmentation model, wherein the image semantic segmentation model comprises a down-sampling module and a sparse multilayer perceptron module, and the image semantic segmentation method comprises the following steps: acquiring an original image, and extracting a downsampling feature map of the original image by using a downsampling module; carrying out linear coding on the down-sampling feature map to obtain a linear coding feature map; performing feature extraction on the linear coding feature map by using a sparse multilayer perceptron module to obtain output features; the image semantic segmentation method based on the image semantic segmentation comprises the steps of training an image semantic segmentation model by utilizing the output features, and executing an image semantic segmentation task by utilizing the trained image semantic segmentation model. The application also discloses an image semantic segmentation device, an electronic device and a storage medium, which have the beneficial effects.', 'The application provides a training method and a related device of an image segmentation model, which are applied to the technical field of artificial intelligence and comprise the following steps: acquiring a first image sample without a segmentation label and at least one second image sample with a segmentation label; respectively carrying out image segmentation on the first image sample and each second image sample through an initial image segmentation model to obtain a first segmentation result of the first image sample and a second segmentation result of the second image sample; determining a value of a first loss function based on the probability map of the acquired first segmentation result in the pixel dimension; determining a value of a second loss function based on a difference between each second segmentation result and the segmentation labels; and training an initial image segmentation model by combining the value of the first loss function and the value of each second loss function to obtain a target image segmentation model. The application can improve the accuracy of the segmentation result of the image segmentation model.', 'The application discloses an image processing method, an image processing device and a storage medium, and specifically comprises the steps of firstly obtaining an image sample to be trained and a label segmentation image corresponding to the image sample to be trained, inputting the image sample to be trained into an image segmentation model to be trained, outputting a corresponding segmentation image sample when the image sample to be trained is extracted through the image segmentation model, calculating a model loss function based on the label segmentation image and the segmentation image sample, optimizing model parameters, generating an optimized image segmentation model, inputting the obtained image to be processed into the optimized image segmentation model, and generating a segmentation image corresponding to the image to be processed. According to the embodiment of the application, the quality of the hidden layer features is further improved by introducing the multilayer decoding output features, the segmentation precision is increased, the segmentation error is effectively reduced, and the identification efficiency and the identification accuracy of the model are improved.']

Name: 28_emotion_comment_text_opinion
Representative_Docs: ['The disclosure provides a text emotion analysis method, an emotion analysis model training method, a device, equipment and a medium, and relates to the field of natural language processing, in particular to the technical field of artificial intelligence and big data. The specific implementation scheme is as follows: and obtaining comment sentences, and inputting the comment sentences into an emotion analysis model, wherein the emotion analysis model is obtained by training a textRNN model through a training data set, and the training data set comprises a plurality of sample comment sentences and emotion analysis results of the NLPC model on each sample comment sentence. And acquiring an emotion analysis result output by the emotion analysis model. The emotion analysis of the comment sentences by using the emotion analysis model in the privatized environment is realized.', 'The invention discloses a multi-emotion recognition method, a system, a medium and equipment combining voice and text, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a target audio frequency consisting of a plurality of audio frequency segments, and converting the target audio frequency into a plurality of corresponding text information by using a voice recognition technology; acquiring audio emotion recognition information based on the voice characteristics of the audio information, and acquiring text emotion recognition information based on the text characteristics of the text information; and combining the two recognition emotions by using a new combination method to obtain target emotion information of the corresponding audio segment. The new combination method is based on speech recognition emotion vectors and text recognition emotion vectors, different combinations are carried out on different emotion information in the two vectors, and then different combinations are used for carrying out emotion combination model training. The method uses the emotion vectors of the recognized voice and the recognized text, so that the voice emotion analysis and the text emotion analysis are independent, the problem of bipolar emotion analysis can be solved, and the method can be applied to a multi-emotion analysis scene.', 'The embodiment provides a text-based emotion classification method and device, computer equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The emotion classification method based on the text comprises the following steps: acquiring original text data to be classified, and performing word segmentation processing on the original text data to obtain a plurality of word segmentation text data; performing data enhancement processing on the word segmentation text data to obtain emotion positive case pairs corresponding to the word segmentation text data; carrying out contrast learning on the positive emotion case pair through a pre-trained contrast learning model to obtain an emotion embedded vector containing emotion characteristics; and then carrying out emotion classification processing according to the emotion embedded vector to obtain a target emotion category corresponding to the emotion characteristics. The emotion classification method has the advantages that the emotion positive case pair is subjected to contrast learning by combining the contrast learning model, emotion classification processing is carried out after emotion embedded vectors are obtained, the problem of unbalanced distribution of training data can be solved, and therefore the emotion classification accuracy is improved.']

Name: 29_power_grid_fault_equipment
Representative_Docs: ['The invention provides a power grid fault diagnosis method, a device, a storage medium and equipment, which comprise the steps of obtaining power grid operation parameters of key nodes of a power grid through a power grid node sensor, sending the power grid operation parameters to an edge calculation node to judge whether the power grid operation parameters are abnormal, marking the abnormal power grid operation parameters and sending the abnormal power grid operation parameters to a cloud platform if the abnormal power grid operation parameters are abnormal, classifying the marked abnormal power grid operation parameters by the cloud platform in combination with historical power grid fault data, and positioning the marked abnormal power grid operation parameters by combining a GIS and a GPS to obtain the power grid fault type and positioning. By combining the edge computing nodes and the cloud platform, the power grid fault abnormality is identified, analyzed and diagnosed in stages, the rapid response fault of the power grid abnormal operation parameters is realized, the power grid fault characteristics can be accurately identified and analyzed by combining the trained model, the efficiency and the accuracy of the power grid fault diagnosis are improved, and the powerful guarantee is provided for the safe and stable operation of the power grid.', 'The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for visually monitoring a power grid based on an intelligent aerial view platform, which relate to the technical field of power grid monitoring and comprise the steps of obtaining point cloud data of power grid equipment, user operation data, historical maintenance data and power grid operation data; the method comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin model, taking output data of the digital twin model as initial power grid state data, determining position information of power grid equipment according to point cloud data, determining fault information of the power grid equipment according to historical maintenance data, carrying out simulation analysis on the position information and the fault information, determining a predicted fault rate of each power grid equipment, determining update frequency of each power grid equipment according to the position information, the predicted fault rate and the historical maintenance data, updating the initial power grid state data corresponding to each power grid equipment according to the update frequency, obtaining real-time power grid state data and displaying the real-time power grid state data. The method sets different sampling update frequencies for different devices, meets the requirement of timely updating data and simultaneously reduces the data processing amount.', 'The invention relates to the technical field of electric power safety management, in particular to an intelligent power grid safety management system and method, comprising the steps of collecting operation data and historical data of a power grid in real time through a monitoring and data collecting module, preprocessing collected data information, and providing a data base for a power grid fault prediction module and a real-time regulation module; according to the preprocessed power grid data information, a power grid fault prediction neural network model is established, and early warning is carried out on power grid risks or faults which will occur in advance, and safety measures are taken; based on the working operation condition of the power grid and by combining the power grid fault prediction result, the load and voltage fluctuation condition of the power grid are regulated and controlled, and the operation efficiency and stability of the power grid are ensured. The invention can ensure the safety and stability of the operation of the power grid, optimize the energy management and the resource utilization, and provide more reliable and safer guarantee for the operation of the power grid.']

Name: 30_human_body_motion_action
Representative_Docs: ['The application discloses a human behavior recognition method, a human behavior recognition device, a mobile terminal and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The method is applied to a mobile terminal, the mobile terminal is connected with a wearable device, the method comprises the steps of collecting motion data of a human body as first motion data, obtaining motion data of a corresponding part of the human body collected by the wearable device as second motion data, inputting the first motion data and the second motion data into a trained human body behavior recognition model, and obtaining the behavior of the human body output by the trained human body behavior recognition model. According to the application, the mobile terminal and the wearable equipment are used for jointly detecting the motion data of the human body so as to be used for identifying the human body behaviors, so that the accuracy and feasibility of identifying the human body behaviors can be improved.', 'The invention provides a human behavior identification method based on a convolutional neural network, which comprises the following steps: collecting images of different human body actions, wherein each image has a human body skeleton sequence; forming a mobile skeleton descriptor image and a mobile joint descriptor image of the human body image according to the human body skeleton sequence; respectively taking the mobile skeleton descriptor images and the mobile joint descriptor images of different human body actions as training sets to train a convolutional neural network; respectively inputting the images of the human body actions to be recognized into the two trained convolutional neural networks to respectively obtain the scores of the human body actions; and adding the scores corresponding to the same human body action in the two scores to obtain the action with the highest score as the result of human body behavior recognition. The method and the device can use the convolutional neural network to identify the human body behaviors for the input human body posture sequence, improve the accuracy of identifying the human body behaviors and reduce the computational complexity of a learning model.', 'The application provides a human body posture detection method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. In the human body posture detection method, an infrared depth image in a target scene is acquired first. And then inputting the infrared depth image into a pre-constructed human body detection model to perform human body detection, so as to obtain a human body region image. And then inputting the human body region image into a pre-constructed human body key point detection model to detect key points, and obtaining coordinates and confidence of human body skeleton key points in the human body region image. And determining the type of each human skeleton key point based on the confidence. Finally, connecting all human skeleton key points based on the types to obtain human skeleton feature vectors, and determining human gestures based on the human skeleton feature vectors. By using the method provided by the application, the key points of the human skeleton can be accurately identified based on the infrared depth image, so that the human skeleton feature vector is obtained, the human posture is determined, and the safety of automatic driving is improved.']

Name: 31_load_power_prediction_consumption
Representative_Docs: ['The application provides a short-term power load prediction method, a short-term power load prediction device, a short-term power load prediction system and a storage medium, wherein the short-term power load prediction method comprises the following steps: collecting and storing load data; selecting characteristic factors influencing load prediction accuracy; preprocessing the collected load data and characteristic factors influencing the load prediction precision, and obtaining a training set and a testing set based on the preprocessed load data and the preprocessed characteristic factors; establishing a load prediction model based on combination of a transducer and a graph rolling network; training and testing a load prediction model by using the training set and the testing set; and inputting the data to be predicted, which is the same as the load data, into a trained load prediction model to obtain a prediction result. The method can solve the problems of static prediction, lack of real-time performance, dependence on historical data, lack of robustness, failure to consider energy transformation, difficult feature extraction and the like in the existing load prediction technology, and improves the prediction precision of the load time sequence.', 'The application discloses a method and a device for predicting power load, a storage medium, an electronic device and a computer program product, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining historical load data of a power system to be predicted; and predicting a second load condition in a second time period in the future based on the historical load data by adopting a second prediction model, wherein the second prediction model is a neural network model. And determining a prediction result of the load condition of the power system in the first time period according to the first load condition and the second load condition. By combining the linear prediction result obtained by the linear prediction model capable of rapidly performing prediction and the prediction result obtained by the neural network model capable of accurately performing prediction, the accurate and real-time power load prediction result can be obtained, and the real-time performance and accuracy of prediction are improved.', 'The invention discloses a power system load prediction method and device based on XGBoost, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining historical power load data of a preset period, preprocessing the historical power load data of the preset period to obtain first power load data, processing the first power load data through a preset XGBoost algorithm to obtain a cross characteristic value, carrying out characteristic processing on the historical power load data of the preset period and the cross characteristic value through a preset characteristic engineering to obtain second characteristic data, carrying out load prediction on the second characteristic data through a preset DNN model to obtain predicted load data, comparing the predicted load data with actual historical load data, and obtaining a long-term load prediction result in a power system through preset screening conditions. The method can better capture the complex nonlinear relation and time sequence characteristics in the actual power load data, improve the accuracy and the robustness of the middle-long-term power load prediction, and improve the load capacity and the operation stability of the power system.']

Name: 32_reinforcement_action_agent_learning
Representative_Docs: ['The invention provides a deep reinforcement learning method and device based on a multi-agent cooperation system, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, wherein the method comprises the following steps: in one-time deep reinforcement learning, acquiring a current distribution and adjustment action of a corresponding collaborative graph of the multi-agent cooperative system based on a pre-constructed deep reinforcement learning network and current observation data, acquiring current reward and punishment data based on the current distribution and adjustment action, optimizing the deep reinforcement learning network based on the current reward and punishment data, and repeatedly executing the steps until a preset convergence condition is reached or a preset learning frequency is reached; the current distribution adjustment action of the collaborative map is updated through multiple times of deep reinforcement learning, the actual action of the intelligent agent is not updated, the steps of the deep reinforcement learning are simplified, multiple times of deep reinforcement learning are quickly carried out under the condition that deep reinforcement learning rewards are sparse, more rewards are accumulated, and therefore the training efficiency of the deep reinforcement learning network is improved, and the convergence speed is low.', 'The invention is suitable for the field of machine learning, and provides a training method, a device, training equipment and a storage medium for a reinforcement learning network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: when a request for training the reinforcement learning network is received, setting network parameters of the reinforcement learning network to perform weight configuration, acquiring the current state of the reinforcement learning network, the reward value and the contribution value of the current state, acquiring the maximum Q value of the action combination in the current state by traversing the action combination of the action library, acquiring the current action according to the maximum Q value of the current state and executing the current action, acquiring the target Q value of the current state by acquiring the maximum Q value of the next state, generating a loss function of the reinforcement learning network, and adjusting the network parameters by a preset adjusting algorithm to continue training the reinforcement learning network until the loss function is converged, so that the calculated amount for training the reinforcement learning network is reduced, the training speed of the reinforcement learning network is increased, and the training efficiency is improved.', 'A motion output method, a network training method and a device for reinforcement learning process are disclosed. The action output method for the reinforcement learning process comprises the steps of determining a first state of an environment where an agent at a current time point is located, determining a first candidate action of the agent at the current time point based on the first state and a first historical action of the agent output to the environment at the previous time point, selecting one target action from the first candidate action and the first historical action, and controlling the agent to output the target action at the current time point. In the embodiment of the disclosure, the same action can be repeated for a plurality of times by the binary switching decision so as to achieve the effect that the action spans a plurality of time points, thereby shortening the task time line, further simplifying the problem of rewarding distribution, and helping to ensure the landing use of the intelligent agent enabled by deep reinforcement learning in an actual application scene.']

Name: 33_pedestrian_gait_crowd_reidentification
Representative_Docs: ['The invention belongs to the field of computer vision and pattern recognition, and particularly relates to a pedestrian searching method, system and device based on a bidirectional interactive network, aiming at solving the problem of low pedestrian searching accuracy caused by the influence of scene information outside a boundary frame on pedestrian characteristics. The system method comprises the following steps: acquiring a t frame image in an input video as an input image; normalizing the input image, and acquiring a search result of a pedestrian target to be searched through a pre-trained pedestrian search model; the pedestrian search model is constructed based on the residual error network, and a new classification layer is added in a classification regression layer of the residual error network and used for obtaining the identity classification probability of the pedestrian target. The invention improves the accuracy of pedestrian search.', 'The application discloses a pedestrian attribute identification method, system, equipment and medium based on relation learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting a pedestrian sample data set; the pedestrian sample data set comprises a plurality of pedestrian samples and attribute tags corresponding to the pedestrian samples; inputting the pedestrian sample data set into a preset pedestrian attribute identification model, and extracting features of the pedestrian sample data set through a feature extraction layer in the pedestrian attribute identification model to obtain first depth features; through a relation learning layer sequentially connected in the pedestrian attribute identification model, the relation among the attribute labels in the first depth feature is learned, and corresponding second depth features and third depth features are obtained; and training the pedestrian attribute recognition model according to the first depth feature, the second depth feature and the third depth feature so as to perform attribute recognition on the acquired pedestrian image to be recognized through the pedestrian attribute recognition model after training, thereby obtaining the corresponding pedestrian attribute.', 'The invention provides a multi-mode pedestrian identity recognition method and system based on pedestrian appearance and gait information, wherein a pedestrian bounding box and a pedestrian outline in a monitoring video are extracted by utilizing a deep convolutional neural network; extracting appearance characteristics from the color pedestrian picture sequence by using a deep convolutional neural network; extracting gait features from the pedestrian contour picture sequence by using a deep convolutional neural network; performing feature fusion on the appearance and gait features extracted from the sub-network based on the attention network model; and comparing and evaluating Euclidean distances among the fusion feature calculation features. The invention fully considers various challenges existing in pedestrian identity recognition in the monitoring system, comprehensively considers the appearance and gait information of pedestrians, and carries out end-to-end extraction and fusion on the two information. The network can more robustly identify the identity of the pedestrian under the interference of pedestrian clothing change, light change, scene change and the like, and has universal applicability.']

Name: 34_battery_charging_lithium_electric
Representative_Docs: ['The invention provides a battery safety detection method, a device and an electronic device, wherein the battery safety detection model is obtained by training an initial characteristic extraction module through a self-supervision representation learning method and a first charging data sample, training a trained intermediate characteristic extraction module and the initial battery safety detection module through a supervised transfer learning method and a second charging data sample, the characteristic extraction module of the battery safety detection model can mine charging rule characteristics of charging data, when the battery safety detection is carried out through the mined charging rule features, the detected battery safety detection result is more accurate, namely the robustness of the battery safety detection model is good, and because the charging rule features of the charging data can be mined, whether the battery is abnormal or not can be distinguished obviously through the charging rule features, and therefore the accuracy of the finally determined battery safety detection result is good.', 'The disclosure relates to a battery charging optimization method of a power exchange station, a battery charging optimization device of the power exchange station, a storage medium and a server. The battery charging optimization method of the battery replacement station comprises the steps of obtaining a charging mode optimization function when the battery replacement station charges a battery in one day; the charging mode optimization function comprises an optimization function formula determined according to different charging conditions, and at least one optimization function formula optimizes the charging cost of the battery in one day of the battery replacement station by taking the charging time of each charging gun for each charging period as an optimization factor; based on the particle swarm model, the optimization factors in the optimization function formula are adjusted through updating the speed and the position, so that the battery charging cost in a day of the battery replacement station is minimum, and reasonable charging time lengths of different charging time periods of each battery in the day of the battery replacement station are determined, so that the charging cost is saved while the requirement of a battery replacement order is met.', 'The invention relates to the technical field of lithium battery charging, in particular to an intelligent lithium battery charging control method based on reinforcement learning, which comprises the following steps: s1, analyzing the structure of a lithium battery and establishing a battery model; s2, initializing state variables, a strategy network and a value network, and setting a reward function; s3, inputting the state variable into a strategy network for iterative training to obtain a target strategy network model; s4, inputting the initial state of the lithium battery to be charged into a target strategy network model, and obtaining a charging strategy. The intelligent charging control method of the lithium battery can output the adaptive charging strategy aiming at different initial states, can also meet the charging under the appointed time, and has strong generalization; meanwhile, the polarization voltage can be reduced and the internal temperature of the battery can be reduced by adopting the charge control method for charging, so that the service life of the lithium battery can be prolonged, and the charge and discharge cycle times of the battery can be increased.']

Name: 35_resource_edge_task_cloud
Representative_Docs: ['The invention discloses a cloud resource dynamic scheduling method based on whale algorithm, which is characterized in that a resource monitoring module of cloud computing resources is utilized to periodically acquire network bandwidth, processor state and node failure rate of each node in the cloud computing resources, calculate computing capacity of each node in the cloud computing resources, then issue a plurality of tasks through a cloud computing system, and calculate task running time of each node in the cloud computing resources and task running cost of each node; a whale algorithm is applied to initialize cloud computing node resource information, task running time and task running cost of each node in cloud computing resources are used as optimization targets, a current optimal target node is searched and moved to the node, local search is conducted, the optimal target node is obtained, and a cloud resource final scheduling scheme is generated through multiple iterations. According to the invention, an optimal resource scheduling scheme is generated by using a global optimization mechanism and a local optimization mechanism of a whale algorithm, an optimal working node is allocated for a cloud computing task, and the utilization rate of cloud computing resources is effectively improved.', 'The invention discloses a low-energy-consumption calculation migration method for a delay-sensitive task of an end-edge cloud hybrid system. According to the method, for the delay sensitive task, constraints such as computing capacity of the mobile device, task scale, computing resources of the edge server and the cloud server are comprehensively considered, and resource allocation amounts of the edge server and the cloud server to each mobile device, and migration relations and migration amounts of the tasks of the mobile device between the edge server and the cloud server are jointly optimized. The energy consumption of the mobile device and the edge server to perform tasks are designed separately. And constructing a mixed integer nonlinear programming problem of minimizing total energy consumption of the end-edge cloud mixed system. A mixed high-dimensional intelligent optimization algorithm with a proxy model and a self-encoder is designed, and the total energy consumption of task execution of an end-edge cloud mixed system is minimized while the maximum delay requirement of the task and the resource constraints of an edge server and a cloud server are met.', 'The invention relates to the field of edge computing and scheduling, in particular to an edge computing and scheduling system based on a knowledge graph. The edge server computing power resource characterization system comprises an edge server computing power resource characterization module, an edge server scheduling module and an edge server visualization module, wherein the edge server computing power resource characterization module comprises resource acquisition and resource modeling functions. The edge server scheduling module comprises task disassembly, task matching, task arrangement and node management functions, can correlate computing power resources and computing tasks of an edge server and match nodes in a knowledge graph to match and arrange and schedule the computing power resources and the computing tasks, and comprises computing power resource visualization and computing task visualization, wherein the computing power resource visualization and the computing task visualization are used for displaying characteristic attributes and task loads of edge computing nodes. The scheduling algorithm can adapt to the change in real time, and the scheduling efficiency and accuracy are improved.']

Name: 36_power_energy_optimization_scheduling
Representative_Docs: ['The embodiment of the disclosure provides a source network load storage collaborative scheduling solving method and device based on an improved genetic algorithm, which are applied to the technical field of active power distribution network operation analysis. The method comprises the steps that historical data of an energy power generation unit, an energy storage unit and a load unit in a micro-grid group system model can be obtained; and inputting the historical data and the preset genetic parameters into a preset genetic algorithm model, and outputting an optimal value of a preset objective function based on a preset constraint rule. In this way, the economic dispatching of the micro-grid group can be completed according to the solved charge and discharge power of the energy storage device under the optimal dispatching scheme and the power generation power of wind power generation and photovoltaic power generation under the optimal dispatching scheme, so that the source network and charge storage collaborative dispatching is performed, the effects of realizing the efficient consumption of renewable energy sources, reducing the running cost of the power distribution network and ensuring the stable running of the power distribution network are achieved.', 'The invention discloses an electric power energy scheduling energy storage system based on artificial intelligence, which comprises an inverter, a control center, an energy storage unit, a speed regulator, an electric power output system, an acquisition module, a wind power prediction module, an analysis module and a decision module. The method comprises the steps of predicting the power generation value of a wind power plant in each power dispatching time period by adopting a machine learning method, calculating the net load value of a power grid, generating a control instruction of an energy storage unit according to the calculation result of the net load value of the power grid, determining the operation gear of a speed regulator by classifying the net load value of the power grid which is negative, and further regulating the speed regulator to select the corresponding operation gear by a control center so as to realize the control of the operation power of a water suction pump, so that the operation state of the energy storage unit can be regulated according to the dispatching information of the power grid, the energy storage regulation strategy of the wind power plant is optimized, and the operation stability of an energy storage system is improved.', 'The invention provides an intelligent power distribution network energy management optimization method based on a dynamic particle swarm algorithm, which comprises the following steps: establishing a decimal mathematical model of the intelligent power distribution network comprising the distributed power supply, the energy storage system and the electric automobile to obtain relevant constraints about adjustable load, the electric automobile and energy storage; determining a demand response mechanism and an energy management strategy to obtain a user power constraint and a real-time power utilization adjustment strategy; establishing a model for minimizing the electricity consumption cost of the electricity users and the power fluctuation of the power grid within a multi-time scale day; and performing energy optimization by using a dynamic particle swarm algorithm with the minimum electricity cost and the minimum power fluctuation as targets. The invention considers the energy exchange of new energy, stored energy and electric vehicles, provides a dynamic energy exchange method for the power distribution network, can dynamically adjust the curve of the power distribution network, and can effectively calculate the optimal value of the energy exchange of the power distribution network through a dynamic particle swarm algorithm.']

Name: 37_anomaly_abnormal_detection_abnormality
Representative_Docs: ['The present embodiments relate to a system and method associated with anomaly classification. The method comprises receiving a plurality of time-series data from one or more sensors associated with a machine. The time-series data may be automatically passed through a convolutional neural network to determine reduced dimension data. An anomaly based on classifying the reduced dimension data may be automatically determined. In a case that the anomaly is an unknown anomaly, the determined anomaly may be labeled and the determined anomaly and its associated label may be stored in an anomaly training database.', 'The embodiment of the specification provides a cloud network anomaly detection model training method based on reinforcement learning and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of inputting historical time sequence data related to equipment to be detected into a first detection network of an anomaly detection model for processing, generating a first anomaly detection result corresponding to the equipment to be detected at least one historical moment, determining a detection error corresponding to the first anomaly detection result, inputting the detection error and at least one historical alarm message of the equipment to be detected into an intelligent agent of a second detection network in the anomaly detection model for processing, generating a second anomaly detection result of the equipment to be detected at a target moment, determining reward information of the second detection network according to the second anomaly detection result and the target anomaly detection result of the equipment to be detected at the target moment, adjusting network parameters of the intelligent agent based on the reward information, and generating a target anomaly detection model.', 'The embodiment of the specification provides a data anomaly detection processing method and device, wherein the data anomaly detection processing method comprises the steps of acquiring data to be detected triggering anomaly detection in a data anomaly detection processing process, carrying out anomaly detection on the data to be detected to obtain anomaly parameters, carrying out multi-mode knowledge extraction according to the data to be detected and the anomaly parameters, carrying out text conversion on a knowledge extraction result to obtain a knowledge text, further constructing an anomaly analysis text based on the knowledge text and an anomaly analysis prompt template corresponding to the data to be detected, finally inputting the anomaly analysis text into a large language model to carry out data anomaly analysis, and obtaining an anomaly analysis processing result and analysis process information, so that the data to be detected is subjected to more comprehensive anomaly detection through the large language model on the basis of knowledge extraction.']

Name: 38_knowledge_graph_entity_entities
Representative_Docs: ['The invention provides a construction method for a knowledge acquisition model in a knowledge graph, which comprises the following steps: constructing a first training set which is formed by taking a plurality of text sentences as input data and taking the relation of any two entities in each sentence in the knowledge graph as a classification result, and training a first neural network; constructing a second training set consisting of triples in a plurality of knowledge graphs, and training a second neural network; taking the input data vector obtained in the second neural network as the attention feature of the first neural network, and constructing a relation extraction model; taking an input data vector obtained from the first neural network as the attention feature of the second neural network, and constructing a knowledge representation model; and fusing the relation extraction model and the knowledge representation model to obtain a model for acquiring knowledge in the knowledge map. The method provided by the invention integrates knowledge representation and relationship extraction two task models simultaneously, can comprehensively extract the characteristics of the knowledge map and the free text, and improves the stability and accuracy of the models.', 'The application provides a knowledge graph construction method, device and equipment, and relates to the field of financial science and technology or other related fields. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a plurality of initial data generated by a plurality of service systems; determining a plurality of pieces of triplet data according to the plurality of pieces of initial data, wherein the triplet data is used for indicating the relation between entities or the attribute of the entities; generating an initial knowledge graph according to the plurality of triples, wherein the initial knowledge graph comprises a plurality of entity nodes and relations among the plurality of entity nodes; and carrying out expansion processing on the relation among the plurality of entity nodes in the initial knowledge graph to obtain a target knowledge graph. According to the method, the accuracy of the knowledge graph is improved.', 'The invention discloses a financial knowledge graph construction method based on a large language model, which comprises the steps of S1, constructing a knowledge pattern, S2, processing text content according to the knowledge pattern constructed in S1 to generate an original knowledge graph, S3, analyzing the original knowledge graph obtained in S2, carrying out knowledge fusion to obtain an optimized knowledge graph, and S4, merging and integrating the optimized knowledge graph obtained in S3 with the existing knowledge graph and carrying out alignment treatment to generate a final knowledge graph. According to the invention, through constructing an industry financial knowledge model, text contents are analyzed and generalized, so that the improvement of massive financial text data processing efficiency is realized, and the manual demand of financial text data processing is greatly reduced. Meanwhile, the extracted knowledge results are combined and aligned, so that the accuracy and regularity of the extracted knowledge are obviously improved. Besides, the compatibility of the existing knowledge graph is realized, so that the constructed financial knowledge graph is more comprehensive and accurate, and the subsequent data analysis is facilitated.']

Name: 39_temperature_air_heat_control
Representative_Docs: ['The application provides an infrared temperature measurement method and device based on decision tree regression and electronic equipment. According to the embodiment of the application, when any infrared temperature measuring device measures the temperature of the target object, the device characteristics of the infrared temperature measuring device such as temperature control level, gain gear and the like and environmental influence factors such as environmental temperature and the like are fully considered, so that the accuracy of the measured temperature is ensured, and the accurate infrared temperature measurement is realized.', 'The invention provides a method, a system, a terminal and a storage medium for identifying the temperature of power equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of detecting keywords of equipment infrared images of the power equipment to be identified to obtain a keyword detection result; the method comprises the steps of carrying out region clipping according to a keyword detection result to obtain a temperature value region, carrying out gray level conversion on the temperature value region to obtain a temperature gray level image, carrying out pixel value conversion on the temperature gray level image, carrying out binarization processing on the temperature gray level image after the pixel value conversion, and inputting the temperature gray level image after the binarization processing into a temperature value identification model to carry out temperature value identification to obtain a highest temperature value and a lowest temperature value of power equipment to be identified. According to the invention, the temperature value identification can be automatically carried out on the temperature gray level graph after the binarization processing based on the temperature value identification model, so that the highest temperature value and the lowest temperature value are obtained, the reading and the recording of the highest temperature value and the lowest temperature value are not needed to be carried out in a manual mode, and the temperature identification efficiency of the power equipment is improved.', 'The invention discloses a temperature detection method and device based on a portable temperature measuring device, relates to the technical field of detection, and mainly aims to solve the problem that the temperature measurement requirement of agility cannot be met. The method comprises the following steps: sending a connection instruction to an Internet of things platform through a preset integration networking protocol; after connection with the Internet of things platform is established, temperature data, distance data and correction parameters which are respectively collected by a temperature sensor and a distance sensor in the portable temperature measuring device are obtained, and the correction parameters are used for representing influence factors acting on a mapping relation between the temperature data and the distance data; based on the mapping relation between the temperature and the distance, carrying out fusion processing on the temperature data and the distance data, and determining a compensation value of the temperature data; and detecting and processing the compensation value, the temperature data and the distance data based on the trained temperature compensation processing model, and determining a detected target temperature value.']

Name: 40_unit_information_first_an
Representative_Docs: ['An output device includes an acquiring unit that acquires a plurality of pieces of output information generated from predetermined target information by a plurality of models each of which generates, from input information, output information that includes a plurality of pieces of information having an order relation. The output device includes a selecting unit that selects, based on a similarity between the plurality of pieces of output information, from among the plurality of pieces of output information, output information that is to be output as association information associated with the target information. The output device includes an output unit that outputs, as the association information, the output information selected by the selecting unit.', 'A system that uses a learning module to realize execution of a predetermined task includes: a first input unit configured to receive information acquired from one or more external systems, and generate at least a portion of information to be input to the learning module; an output unit configured to acquire information output from the learning module, and generate information to be output from the system, the information output from the system being information based on which execution of a predetermined task is to be realized; and a second input unit configured to receive an input from a user so that information based on the input from the user is input to at least one of the first input unit, the learning module, and the output unit, and information output from the output unit varies based on the input from the user.', 'An information processing device includes a storage unit that stores learning information acquired by machine learning, an input unit that acquires identification information, and a processing unit that performs recognition processing using the learning information that is specified by the storage unit on a basis of the identification information. An information processing method is executed by a processor, the information processing method includes storing learning information acquired by machine learning, acquiring identification information, and performing recognition processing using the learning information that is specified from storage on a basis of the identification information.']

Name: 41_image_classification_feature_images
Representative_Docs: ['The application discloses an image classification model training method and device, computer equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of image processing. According to the method, the classification result of each image output by the image classification model is obtained, when the classification result output by the image classification model does not meet the reference condition, a reference classification result is constructed based on the classification result output by the image classification model, and the reference classification result can indicate the probability that the image belongs to each category, so that the parameters of the image classification model are updated based on the total error value between the classification result of each image and the reference classification result, a trained image classification model is obtained, the trained image classification model can directly output the image classification result with higher accuracy based on the input image, and the complexity of the image classification process of the image classification model is reduced.', 'The embodiment of the application discloses an image identification method, an image identification device, image identification equipment and a readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a target image, inputting the target image into an image recognition model, and extracting image characteristics of the target image from the image recognition model; respectively inputting the image features into an image classification component and a position prediction component in an image recognition model; in the image classification component, carrying out convolution processing on the image characteristics through a first convolution parameter to obtain a classification convolution characteristic diagram; in the position prediction component, carrying out convolution processing on the image characteristics through a second convolution parameter to obtain a position convolution characteristic diagram; and outputting the object class of the target object in the target image according to the classification convolution feature map, and outputting the position information of the target object in the target image according to the position convolution feature map. By the adoption of the method and the device, the image recognition efficiency can be improved.', 'The application relates to an image recognition method, an image recognition device, a computer device and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring an image data set to be identified; inputting the image data set to be identified into a classification model, and outputting a type label corresponding to the image data set to be identified by the classification model; the classification model is obtained by taking each training picture in the training picture set as input and taking the type label of the corresponding training picture as output to train a preset network model; the network model includes: the convolutional neural network model is used for extracting basic features of the training picture, the first convolutional neural network is used for convolving the basic features to obtain local features of the training picture, and the second convolutional neural network is used for convolving the basic features to obtain global features of the training picture. By adopting the method, the image classification and identification accuracy and efficiency can be improved.']

Name: 42_cloud_point_threedimensional_laser
Representative_Docs: ['A method, an apparatus and an electronic device for processing point cloud data and a computer readable storage medium are disclosed. The method includes: receiving first point cloud data acquired by a laser scanner; classifying the first point cloud data to obtain second point cloud data which is classified; judging if the second point cloud data at least comprises target point cloud data, and whether a distance between other point cloud data in the second point cloud data and the target point cloud data is smaller than a first preset threshold value; if yes, determining the other point cloud data as hazardous point cloud data.', 'The disclosure provides a point cloud segmentation method, which comprises the steps of obtaining first point cloud characteristic information corresponding to an input point cloud, wherein the first point cloud characteristic information comprises initial characteristic information of each target point in the input point cloud, processing the first point cloud characteristic information through a target operator to obtain second point cloud characteristic information, determining third point cloud characteristic information according to the second point cloud characteristic information in a frequency domain conversion processing process in an operation process of the target operator, determining a point cloud segmentation result of the input point cloud according to the third point cloud characteristic information, and determining transformation characteristic information corresponding to each target point. The disclosure also provides a point cloud segmentation device.', 'The invention provides a method for processing point cloud data, which comprises the steps of obtaining the point cloud data and semantic information corresponding to the point cloud data; and providing the point cloud data and the semantic information as input to a neural network to obtain the point cloud data with enhanced density.']

Name: 43_gesture_hand_recognition_motion
Representative_Docs: ['The application provides a gesture recognition method and a gesture recognition device, wherein the gesture recognition method comprises the following steps: acquiring an infrared image and depth data acquired by a flight time camera; determining hand coordinates based on the infrared image; performing background removal processing on the depth data based on the hand coordinates to obtain a gesture depth image after background removal; converting the gesture depth image into point cloud data; from the point cloud data, a gesture type is identified. Therefore, the influence of illumination intensity change can be reduced, the method is suitable for various application scenes, the geometrical shape information and the spatial position posture of the gesture are expressed more truly and accurately, and the recognition accuracy and stability of the dynamic gesture are greatly improved.', 'The invention discloses a method suitable for gesture recognition, which comprises the following steps: acquiring hand activity information through a sensing unit; transmitting the hand activity information to a cloud service platform; establishing a gesture recognition model, and analyzing hand activity information through the gesture recognition model to obtain a gesture recognition result; the cloud service platform pushes the gesture recognition result to the user side, and the user side controls the corresponding device through the open access interface; the invention constructs the gesture recognition model combining the transfer learning and the active learning to solve the problems of personalized training and cold start of the gesture recognition model, can transfer the knowledge of the existing gesture recognition model to the gesture recognition model of a specific individual, and improves the rapid adaptability and performance of the model in a new user, a new environment and a new scene.', 'The invention provides a control gesture recognition method in an augmented reality environment, which comprises the following steps: a data acquisition step: acquiring depth data of human hands by tracking through a depth camera, and calculating three-dimensional coordinates of hand key points to acquire a motion characteristic sequence of the hand key points; a neural network processing step: tracking and identifying the motion characteristic sequence of the hand key points to obtain a characteristic sequence of the gesture; a gesture recognition step: and obtaining a gesture recognition result according to the feature sequence of the gesture. Correspondingly, the invention further provides a control gesture recognition system in the augmented reality environment. The invention can accurately and quickly identify the gesture, reduces the resource occupation and improves the robustness and the real-time property.']

Name: 44_neuron_synapse_circuit_memristor
Representative_Docs: ['The present invention relates to the neuromorphic calculating fields based on memristor, more particularly to the neuron circuit in the impulsive neural networks based on STDP (Spiking timing dependent plasticity) rule.The working mechanism of biological neuron and memristor nerve synapse drive demand in integrated pulse neural network framework, designing one kind can be used for that memristor nerve synapse is driven to complete the LIF type neuron circuit that class brain (neuromorphic) calculates, to realize the function of neuron.The present invention not only realizes integral ignition function, is provided simultaneously with the network characteristic of the biological neurons such as quiescent stage, lateral inhibition, transmitted in both directions；The network struction between neuron can be realized without external digital control signal；Based on mature cmos circuit technology, reliability with higher；Using high power amplifier unit, there is stronger driving capability.It can satisfy the needs of memristor weight on-line tuning, the unsupervised pulse network framework of building and extensive memristor class brain computing system etc..', 'The present invention relates to a spiking neural network circuit. The spiking neural network circuit can achieve high degree of integration and low power consumption by including a plurality of synapse devices implemented in the form of a floating gate memristor in each row of a matrix structure and a neural device having a global floating gate (GPG) structure charged or discharged through a voltage output from the plurality of synapse devices. To this end, the present invention has one neuron device and a plurality of synapse devices in each column of a matrix structure. The neuron device includes a global floating gate (GFG) charged with a voltage output from the plurality of synapse devices. As the voltage of the GFG exceeds a threshold value, a spike voltage (-V_post) is output to reset the GFG, and the electric resistance of the plurality of synapse devices is increased. The plurality of synapse devices include a first electrode, a second electrode, and a diode. The first electrode receives a spike voltage V_pre output from a neuron device positioned in a previous column. The second electrode outputs a voltage to the GFG of the neuron device, and receives the spike voltage -V_post output from the neuron device. The diode transmits, to the second electrode, the spike voltage -V_post output from the neuron device.', 'There is provided a neural network circuit device including a plurality of synapse circuits storing a synaptic coupling weight and a neuron circuit connected to the plurality of synapse circuits. The plurality of synapse circuits store the synaptic coupling weight in a non-volatile manner and output a voltage signal having a magnitude based on the stored synaptic coupling weight in response to an input signal. The neuron circuit includes a neuron MOS transistor having a floating gate and a plurality of control gates which are capacitively coupled to the floating gate and to which the voltage signals from the plurality of synapse circuits are input respectively, and a pulse generator outputting a pulse signal by turning on or off the neuron MOS transistor.']

Name: 45_process_material_parameters_production
Representative_Docs: ['The application relates to the technical field of cutter detection and discloses a composite material processing cutter passivation detection system and method based on data processing. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring data of a cutter in the processing process of the composite material through the current processing parameter combination to obtain a standardized time sequence data set; extracting features and reducing the dimension of the features to obtain a cutter state feature vector; modeling and fuzzy analysis are carried out on the response surface, and a wear response curve is obtained; performing piecewise regression analysis and parameter integration to obtain a cutter abrasion prediction model; acquiring a target sensing data set in real time, and predicting cutter wear through a cutter wear prediction model to obtain a real-time estimated value of the cutter passivation degree; according to the real-time estimated value, bayesian inference and parameter optimization are carried out on the current processing parameter combination to obtain a target processing parameter combination.', 'The invention discloses an intelligent grading and optimizing method for parameters of a light alloy die casting process, which comprises the following steps: performing dimension reduction on a data set based on light alloy industrial die casting; calculating the number of defective types which are corresponding to each group of process parameter combinations and lead to the scrapping of the castings, and taking the number as the dividing standard for evaluating the quality of the process parameters and the output of the model; calculating the number of samples corresponding to different defect types in the data set, and realizing the homogenization of the label distribution of the data set through an oversampling and downsampling algorithm; determining the super parameters of the random forest model, training according to the data set, and establishing a mapping relation between the technological parameter combination of the light alloy die casting and the defect type number, so as to obtain a standard evaluation model; the prediction of defect types is realized by inputting a process parameter combination, and the process parameter quality of the light alloy industrial die casting is evaluated; if the defect type in the predicted result is greater than 0, automatic optimization recommendation of optimizing the process parameters is realized through grid search. The model prediction of the method is accurate and efficient; process parameter optimization suggestions can be given.', 'The invention is applicable to the technical field of casting processes, and provides an intelligent optimization method for investment casting process parameters based on machine learning, which comprises the following steps: collecting data of wax injection and pouring processes, performing data preprocessing, and selecting key features to construct a data set; constructing a data model taking the process yield as output based on the ensemble learning XGBoost; taking the constructed data model as an optimized function, and searching an optimal technological parameter combination through a particle swarm intelligent optimization algorithm; the optimized process parameters in the optimal process parameter combination are verified in numerical simulation software.
