And searching optimal technological parameters by using a particle swarm algorithm based on the data model, so that the production cost, the product design and the trial production period are reduced, the optimization of the technological parameters is realized, and the technological yield of the casting is improved.']

Name: 46_risk_credit_financial_enterprise
Representative_Docs: ['The invention discloses a credit risk assessment method, a credit risk assessment device, computer equipment and a storage medium, relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and mainly aims to improve the accuracy rate of credit risk assessment and ensure the reliability of a credit risk assessment result. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring consumption behavior time sequence data and attribute data corresponding to a user to be evaluated; inputting the consumption behavior time sequence data into a preset consumption behavior feature extraction model for feature extraction to obtain consumption behavior feature vectors corresponding to the consumption behavior time sequence data; inputting the attribute data into a preset attribute feature extraction model for feature extraction to obtain an attribute feature vector corresponding to the user to be evaluated; and determining a credit risk evaluation result corresponding to the user to be evaluated according to the consumption behavior feature vector and the attribute feature vector. The invention adopts machine learning technology, and is mainly suitable for credit risk assessment.', 'A kind of user credit methods of risk assessment and device, computer readable storage medium, the user credit methods of risk assessment include: the operation data for obtaining user in preset application software；The operation data of the user is input in Credit Risk Assessment Model and carries out risk assessment, obtains the overdue probability of the user；Export the overdue probability of the user.Using the above scheme, crowd that can be less to no collage-credit data or collage-credit data carries out assessing credit risks.', 'The application provides a credit risk prediction method, a credit risk prediction device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The method comprises the steps of obtaining target credit data of a target object, inputting the target credit data into a trained large language model to obtain a plurality of risk sub-scores output by the trained large language model, wherein different risk sub-scores are risk values of the target object in different risk dimensions, the risk dimensions at least comprise a behavior dimension, a consumption dimension and a trust dimension, and determining a credit overdue risk value of the target object based on the plurality of risk sub-scores and scoring weights corresponding to the risk sub-scores. The method can improve the accuracy of the finally generated credit overdue risk value.']

Name: 47_graph_node_nodes_network
Representative_Docs: ['The invention discloses a graph classification method based on an attention mechanism, which comprises the steps of acquiring an original graph network and corresponding graph network data information; initializing feature embedding of nodes, constructing a higher-order graph network and initializing node embedding in the higher-order graph network; nodes in each-level graph network adopt a substructure interaction attention network to capture and absorb neighbor node information and interaction information between neighbor nodes and train to obtain new feature embedding of each node in the graph network; and embedding and fusing node characteristics in the graph network into graph network embedding by adopting a node attention network, and classifying the dimension reduction through a multi-layer perceptron after cascading each-order graph network embedding to obtain a final graph network classification result. The invention also discloses a compound toxicity prediction method comprising the graph classification method based on the attention mechanism. The method effectively improves the accuracy of graph network classification and the accuracy of compound toxicity prediction; and the efficiency is higher, the accuracy is better and easy to implement.', 'The invention provides a node classification method, a node classification system, a readable storage medium and computer equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an attribute graph, and calculating a topology similarity matrix and an attribute similarity matrix of each node according to the attribute graph; calculating a similarity matrix of each node by using a graph neural network model; optimizing parameters of the graph neural network model according to the topological similarity matrix, the attribute similarity matrix and the similarity matrix to obtain an optimized graph neural network model; inputting the attribute graph into the optimized graph neural network model to obtain an embedded vector of each node in the attribute graph; and constructing a node classification model, and inputting the embedded vector of each node to obtain the node classification of each node in the attribute graph. According to the invention, the embedded vector of each node on the attribute graph can be obtained without marking data, and the optimized graph neural network model generates the embedded vector containing more topological information and attribute information aiming at each node on the attribute graph, so that the nodes are classified more accurately.', 'Embodiments of the present description provide data access methods and apparatus for a distributed image learning architecture. In the data access method, the graph nodes at the first graph learning device are grouped into a plurality of graph node groups with priorities, the priorities of the graph node groups are determined based on graph node dependency relationships, and the graph node dependency relationships are used for reflecting the dependency of the graph nodes relative to mirror nodes during graph learning. Determining mirror nodes on which each graph node group depends based on graph node dependency; and distributing cache space for the mirror image nodes depended on by the graph node groups from the common buffer area of the first graph learning device according to the priorities of the graph node groups. Aiming at the graph node which completes the distribution of the cache space, initiating a data access process to a second graph learning device where the corresponding graph node of the mirror image node which the graph node depends on is located; and caching the acquired graph node data in the allocated cache space.']

Name: 48_quantization_compression_neural_network
Representative_Docs: ['The application relates to a mixed precision quantization method, a device, equipment and a medium thereof in the technical field of network live broadcast, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining each quantized model instance obtained by quantizing an original model and a quantized model instance with the minimum corresponding output error between the original model as a candidate quantized model; and determining a characteristic mean value error between the candidate quantization model and the output results corresponding to each same layer in the original model, and when each characteristic mean value error is smaller than a first threshold value, confirming that the candidate quantization model is a target quantization model, otherwise, determining a qualified quantization sensitive layer according to whether a plurality of characteristic error indexes between the candidate quantization model and the output results corresponding to each same layer in the original model reach standards, and iteratively executing all the steps until the target quantization model is confirmed under the condition that the quantization sensitive layer of the original model is not quantized. The method and the device can ensure that the output error of the mixed precision quantization model is minimized.', 'The invention discloses a neural network model quantization method, a system, a device and a computer readable medium, belonging to the technical field of neural networks and aiming at solving the technical problem of how to avoid calculating an activation value quantization factor during reasoning. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a neural network model, and training the neural network model; for the target model, calculating a model weight quantization factor based on a quantization range by calculating a maximum value of an absolute value of the model weight; for each layer of the target model, calculating an activation value quantization factor of each layer of the target model by minimizing a mean square error; for each layer of the target model, carrying out model reasoning through the quantized weight and activation value of the fixed point type, and inversely quantizing the reasoning result into an int32 data type; for each layer of the target model, each operator is quantized in an asymmetric quantization manner, the floating point type model weight is quantized to int8 data type, and the activation value is quantized to the unt 8 data type.', 'The invention provides a knowledge distillation-based convolutional neural network quantization method, which relates to the technical field of convolutional neural networks, and adopts a dynamic search mode to obtain the optimal clipping proportion and quantization bit number of each network weight layer of the convolutional neural network. In the quantization compression process of the convolutional neural network, a teacher network is used for fine adjustment training based on knowledge distillation, different quantization precision can be adopted for different network weight layers of the convolutional neural network, network precision cannot be excessively lost, and the compression degree of the convolutional neural network can be increased in the quantization process.']

Name: 49_traffic_flow_road_prediction
Representative_Docs: ['A road network flow prediction method comprises the following steps: obtaining road network data in a target area and traffic flow data in a period of time to obtain a traffic flow raster graph, inputting the traffic flow raster graph into a CNN (continuous traffic network), and training a model to obtain a short-time traffic flow prediction model; comprehensively considering dynamic and static factors to obtain traffic flow similarity in different areas; similarity analysis is carried out on a large number of regions and the regions of the trained traffic flow prediction model to obtain a series of traffic flow similarities, the regions in the same similarity level are screened out to obtain road networks and traffic flow data of the regions, the trained traffic flow prediction model is input to obtain a prediction result, and the prediction result is compared with the actual traffic flow data to obtain the accuracy of traffic flow prediction of each region; and setting the prediction accuracy, and performing traffic flow prediction on the region with the similarity greater than or equal to the similarity grade by using a trained traffic flow prediction model and combining the real-time traffic flow data of the region according to the similarity grade of the corresponding region.', 'The invention discloses an intelligent traffic monitoring method and device of the Internet of things, which are characterized in that traffic flow information is acquired through a plurality of traffic flow detectors arranged on a traffic road, the traffic flow information outputs the interval intuitionistic fuzzy number of traffic flow through a traffic flow detection module, a plurality of groups of environment parameter sensors are arranged on the traffic road to detect environment parameters of temperature, visibility, rainfall, dust and wind speed, the output value of the traffic flow detection module and the environment parameters are used as input, the detected road traffic flow value under the influence of the environment parameters is determined through a road traffic intelligent monitoring module, the detected road traffic flow value detected by the road traffic intelligent monitoring modules is used as input, and 4 predicted values of traffic flow in the east, south, west and north directions are output through a regional traffic intelligent monitoring subsystem. Compared with the prior art, the invention can automatically obtain the traffic information in the monitoring area in real time, and can effectively adjust the traffic flow of road sections, so that the traffic of each road section is smoother.', 'The invention relates to the field of urban traffic flow prediction, in particular to a traffic flow prediction method based on a dynamic causal graph network, which comprises the steps of collecting historical traffic flow data in an area to be predicted, and carrying out standardized preprocessing on the historical traffic flow data to obtain a standard data set; the traffic flow prediction method comprises the steps of establishing a traffic flow prediction model based on dynamic causal network guidance, wherein the traffic flow prediction model can conduct space-time feature extraction, causal structure learning and traffic flow prediction on input traffic flow data, determining a Lagrange loss function, training the traffic flow prediction model by using the standard data set and minimizing the Lagrange loss function as an optimization target, inputting historical traffic flow data of a region to be predicted into the trained traffic flow prediction model, and obtaining future traffic flow.']

Name: 50_photovoltaic_power_solar_prediction
Representative_Docs: ['The disclosure provides a training method and a training device for a photovoltaic power generation power prediction model, which relate to the technical field of photovoltaic power generation and comprise the following steps: acquiring historical weather data and corresponding historical photovoltaic power generation power of a photovoltaic power station, and preprocessing the historical weather data and the historical photovoltaic power generation power; taking the preprocessed historical weather data and simulated rainfall data generated by the preprocessed historical weather data as training data, and taking the historical photovoltaic power generation power corresponding to the training data as a data tag; inputting training data into BiLSTM models to obtain prediction results; determining target super parameters according to the prediction result, the data tag and the initial super parameters of BiLSTM models by utilizing an improved sparrow search algorithm; and optimizing the BiLSTM model based on the target super-parameters to obtain a photovoltaic power generation power prediction model. The process can improve the prediction precision of the photovoltaic power generation power prediction model in a rainy day state.', 'The invention discloses a deep learning-based photovoltaic power generation power prediction method, which relates to the field of photovoltaic power generation power prediction and comprises the steps of acquiring multi-source data comprising process data and environment data based on a photovoltaic power generation running state, evaluating the quality state of the multi-source data by combining a graph embedding technology after optimizing the multi-source data, extracting the characteristic state of the multi-source data according to a quality state evaluation result, constructing a photovoltaic power generation power prediction model, outputting an accuracy prediction result of the photovoltaic power generation power prediction model based on a loss function, combining a Newton method and the accuracy prediction result, optimizing the photovoltaic power generation power prediction model, verifying the accuracy of the photovoltaic power generation power prediction result, and determining photovoltaic power generation power output. The invention solves the problems of intermittence, volatility and the like in the integration of the photovoltaic system and the power grid by using the long-short-term memory model, and can improve the prediction precision of photovoltaic power generation by learning historical data, meteorological data and environmental data.', 'The invention relates to the technical field of photovoltaic power, in particular to a photovoltaic power prediction system and a photovoltaic power prediction method based on artificial intelligence, wherein the photovoltaic power prediction system comprises the steps of acquiring historical operation work data and air image data of a photovoltaic power generation system through a sensor and monitoring equipment, calculating a temperature correction coefficient of a photovoltaic cell panel, and setting illumination intensity acquisition frequency according to the obtained illumination intensity; preprocessing and extracting features of the collected data, establishing a photovoltaic power prediction neural network model, predicting photovoltaic power, and predicting photovoltaic power in a future period of time to obtain a prediction result; combining the temperature correction coefficient and the illumination intensity acquisition frequency parameter, establishing a photovoltaic power optimization model, and optimizing the predicted photovoltaic power to improve the accuracy of power prediction; and carrying out operation and scheduling decisions of the photovoltaic power generation system according to the prediction and optimization results of the photovoltaic power. The invention improves the photovoltaic power prediction accuracy and realizes good energy utilization and system performance.']

Name: 51_entity_named_relation_word
Representative_Docs: ['The invention belongs to the technical field of natural language processing, and relates to a named entity recognition method based on a conditional random field, which comprises the following steps: receiving a word sequence comprising Chinese text; arranging all words in the word sequence according to the context sequence of the words in the original sentence; encoding the word sequence into a word vector group using a word vector module of the named entity recognition network; the word vector group comprises named entity characteristic information of each word; extracting sequence characteristics of each word vector in the word vector group by using a long and short memory network module of the named entity recognition network, and outputting a state score matrix of a named entity classification space; and searching the score path with the highest score in the state score matrix by using a conditional random field module of the named entity recognition network, and outputting the score path as a named entity prediction result of each word in the word sequence. The invention provides an efficient named entity identification method, and particularly relates to entity identification of names of people, organizations and places related to financial bill pictures.', 'The application provides a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for determining entity relationship, wherein the method comprises the following steps: entity extraction is carried out based on the initial data text, and entity information is obtained; acquiring a tag set, and training an entity relation classification model based on entity information to acquire a plurality of initial relation tags corresponding to the entity information in the tag set, wherein the entity relation classification model comprises N entity relation classification sub-models, and N is an integer greater than 2; and determining a final relationship label corresponding to the entity information based on the plurality of initial relationship labels.', 'The invention provides a method and a device for extracting entity relations, and relates to the technical fields of data processing and data mining. According to the entity relation extraction method and device, when the second entity and the entity relation text which have the preset logic association with the first entity are extracted from the target corpus containing the first entity, the entity relation extraction model is firstly trained in advance, the first entity and the target corpus are input into the entity relation extraction model, the entity relation extraction model can output the second entity and the entity relation text, and therefore the entity relation triplet containing the first entity, the entity relation text and the second entity is obtained.']

Name: 52_image_restoration_enhancement_network
Representative_Docs: ['An image restoration method, an image restoration device and a computer-readable storage medium, wherein the image restoration method comprises the following steps: obtaining a degraded image; inputting the degraded image into a preset image restoration model, wherein the image restoration model is obtained based on full convolution network training; adopting an image restoration model to restore the degraded image to obtain a restored image, comprising: and (3) performing convolution on the degraded image to respectively obtain a plurality of characteristic images with different scales, wherein the plurality of characteristic images with different scales comprise: the method comprises the steps that a first characteristic image of a first scale and a second characteristic image of a second scale are obtained, wherein the second scale is larger than the first scale, and the step length of at least one convolution layer in convolution layers adopted by the second characteristic image is larger than 1; cascading based on a plurality of characteristic images with different scales, performing characteristic fusion on the cascaded characteristic images, and restoring based on the fused characteristic images to obtain restored images. The scheme can give consideration to the image restoration effect and the calculation capability requirement of the mobile equipment.', 'The application discloses an implementation method of image enhancement, a related device and equipment, wherein the implementation method of the image enhancement comprises the following steps: acquiring an image to be enhanced; performing image enhancement on the image to be enhanced by utilizing an image enhancement model based on the type of the image to be enhanced; the image enhancement model is obtained by enhancing a sample image through an initial model to obtain a predicted image, and adjusting parameters of the initial model and/or comparing and displaying the sample image and the predicted image by using a visualization tool, wherein the type of the sample image is the same as that of the image to be enhanced. According to the scheme, the enhancement effect and efficiency of image enhancement can be improved.', 'The invention discloses a VITs-based image restoration method, and relates to a VITs-based image restoration method. The invention aims to solve the problems that the restored image has low precision in the existing method which is mostly based on the restored image of the convolutional neural network. The image restoration method based on VITs comprises the following specific processes: step one, acquiring a pair of a degraded image and a reference real image of an automobile in various driving environments as a training set; step two, constructing an image restoration network; training an image restoration network based on a training set to obtain a trained image restoration network; and step four, acquiring a degradation image to be detected, and inputting the degradation image to a trained image restoration network to obtain a restoration image. The invention is used in the field of image restoration.']

Name: 53_tracking_target_frame_track
Representative_Docs: ['The invention discloses a visual target tracking method and a terminal based on an attention mechanism, which belong to the technical field of target tracking and sequentially comprise the following steps: feature extraction, target detection, target re-identification and target tracking matching: assigning unique IDs for detection targets in the first frame of image; predicting a next location of each tracking target; associating the current frame detection target with the tracking target; and updating the state of the tracked target and the target re-identification information according to the target association result, and repeating the target tracking and matching steps to realize multi-target matching and tracking. And a tracking model which completes combined training with the target detection model is adopted to execute a target tracking matching algorithm, and target detection and tracking are combined in the same network model, so that the calculation and reasoning complexity is reduced, and the calculation cost and time delay are reduced. Meanwhile, the combined training is performed by optimizing the combined loss function of target detection and target tracking, so that the problem of false detection and missing detection can be avoided to a certain extent.', 'The embodiment of the application discloses a visual tracking method, a visual tracking device, electronic equipment, a computer readable storage medium and a computer program, wherein the visual tracking method comprises the following steps: aiming at a current image in an image sequence, acquiring an image block of a target object; inputting the image blocks into a tracking control network to acquire tracking strategy information of the target object; tracking the target object according to the tracking strategy information; the tracking control network is obtained by training in a reinforcement learning mode by utilizing a sample image sequence provided with target object position marking information.', 'The invention discloses a feature association multi-target tracking method based on a transformer, which comprises the following steps of obtaining a video frame of a video to be tracked, inputting the video frame into a preset feature extraction network and carrying out target detection to obtain a plurality of detection frames and corresponding tracking targets thereof, distributing a target tracker for each tracking target, and obtaining a tracking frame of the tracking target in the next frame according to the detection frames, wherein feature enhancement and suppression are carried out based on feature codes of a convolutional neural network and a transformer network and feature decoding of a mutual attention mechanism when the tracking frames of the plurality of tracking targets are overlapped, so as to obtain an updated tracking frame. The invention can track the target better in the long-time video frame more accurately, especially in the case that multiple targets are seriously shaded, and mark the tracked target in the video frame by the tracking frame.']

Name: 54_virtual_reality_user_display
Representative_Docs: ['The invention relates to an interactive display device based on augmented reality and an interactive display method thereof, wherein the device comprises: the system comprises a visual perception unit, a sound input and output unit, an augmented reality processing unit and a video output unit, wherein the augmented reality processing unit comprises a voice recognition module, a gesture recognition module, a target positioning module, a three-dimensional registration module and a virtual object superposition module. The method comprises the steps of detecting and displaying an acquired original video; tracking a target object; and when the time of continuously tracking the target object is longer than T1, recognizing the voice collected from the sound input and output unit, selecting an augmented reality mode according to the recognized voice instruction, superposing a virtual effect, selecting the augmented reality mode according to whether the current target object is tracked and whether a new voice instruction exists, continuously superposing the virtual effect or finishing the augmented reality interactive display. The invention fully utilizes the augmented reality technology and the artificial intelligence technology, and effectively improves the user experience of interactive display.', 'The invention discloses a method for collecting simulated learning data by using a virtual reality technology, which belongs to the technical field of virtual reality and comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps: acquiring scene image data, imitating a real scene, and building a virtual scene in a three-dimensional engine; step two: at least one operational virtual model object is set up as a proxy in the virtual scene in a geometric manner. Compared with the traditional method for artificially demonstrating by using a keyboard, the method combines the simulated learning and the virtual reality technology, provides a feasible scheme for training the agent with complexity, is convenient for collecting simulated learning data and improves the model training efficiency; the simulation learning data collection can be realized by utilizing the virtual reality, and the model training efficiency is improved.', 'Disclosed is an apparatus and method of monitoring a VR (Virtual Reality) sickness prediction model for virtual reality content. A method of monitoring a VR sickness prediction model according to the present disclosure includes: displaying the virtual reality content on a display unit; acquiring an user input; analyzing the virtual reality content on a basis of the acquired user input; and displaying an analysis result for the virtual reality content on the display unit.']

Name: 55_fire_smoke_flame_detection
Representative_Docs: ['The invention provides a forest fire monitoring method based on multi-element composite deep learning, which comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring a historical fire picture to generate a historical fire data set; s2, training a YOLO-V8 convolutional neural network model by using a historical fire data set to obtain a forest fire detection model; s3, acquiring a real-time fire disaster picture, and inputting the real-time fire disaster picture into a forest fire disaster detection model; s4, extracting the space-time characteristics of the detected forest fire picture through a space-time convolution network; s5, outputting the type and the fire development stage of the forest fire corresponding to the real-time fire picture. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the development stage of the forest fire is predicted by inputting the real-time fire picture into the forest fire detection model, so that corresponding fire extinguishing measures can be conveniently taken subsequently, and the fire extinguishing efficiency is improved.', 'Disclosed is a fire prediction system which analyzes real-time measurement information collected from fire detection facilities with a pre-learned artificial intelligence (AI) engine to detect areas of high-risk buildings to prevent fire and predicts a fire spread (deployment) path in the event of a fire to select and guide a section with a low risk for fire and fire suppression as an evacuation route. To this end, the fire prediction system comprises: a plurality of fire detectors detecting one or more fire elements to generate and transmit fire information including real-time measurement information; and a first receiver analyzing whether a fire has occurred in an area monitored by each fire detector on the basis of the fire information transmitted from the corresponding fire detector and analyzing fire information of a non-fire situation with an AI engine learning change in fire information in the case of a fire through deep learning-based machine learning to generate warning information predicting the possibility of a fire. Accordingly, real-time measurement information, such as temperature information, smoke information, and the like, collected from a fire detector can be analyzed with a deep learning-based AI even before a fire occurs so that an area where a fire will occur can be predicted, thereby preventing the fire.', 'The application relates to a fire detection method and device applied to a campus smart platform and computer equipment. The method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of firstly predicting a real-time scene image to be detected by utilizing a trained deep learning model to obtain a fire prediction area in the image, obtaining whether the area is of a smoke type or a fire type, then carrying out background modeling according to the image of the fire scene to obtain a dynamic change area of the fire, finally determining whether the fire or the smoke occurs in the fire scene by calculating an IOU value of the fire prediction area and the dynamic change area, and enabling a detector to know the size and the degree of the fire in the fire scene according to a final judgment result and the smoke type or the fire type, so that corresponding measures can be made. The method can effectively improve the accuracy of detection.']

Name: 56_remote_sensing_image_change
Representative_Docs: ['The invention relates to the technical field of remote sensing images, in particular to a remote sensing image change detection method and a remote sensing image change detection system based on priori knowledge and frequency domain learning, wherein the method comprises the steps of inputting a first time phase remote sensing image and a second time phase remote sensing image to be detected into a trained remote sensing image change detection model to obtain a change prediction result of the two images; the model performs feature extraction processing on a first time-phase remote sensing image to obtain a preprocessed feature of the first time-phase remote sensing image, performs feature extraction processing on a second time-phase remote sensing image to obtain a preprocessed feature of the second time-phase remote sensing image, performs feature filtering on the preprocessed feature of the first time-phase remote sensing image and the preprocessed feature of the second time-phase remote sensing image to obtain a filtered frequency feature, further processes the filtered frequency feature to generate a final difference fusion feature, and generates a change prediction result of the two images based on the final difference fusion feature. The invention can give an accurate change prediction result.', 'The invention belongs to the technical field of high-resolution remote sensing image processing and remote sensing image data mining, and particularly relates to a remote sensing image change detection method and a remote sensing image change detection system based on dynamic weighting cross entropy loss. The method comprises the steps of 1, manufacturing a change detection data set based on a high-resolution remote sensing image, 2, constructing a remote sensing image change detection model based on a weight sharing twin neural network, 3, designing a dynamic weighted cross entropy loss function and an optimizer, 4, training an improved deep learning model by using the high-resolution remote sensing change detection data set, 5, predicting the test data set by using data enhancement in test, and carrying out post-processing operation to improve the prediction quality. The method is used for solving the problem of the deficiency of the remote sensing image change detection algorithm.', 'According to the method and the device for identifying the remote sensing image, provided by the invention, the remote sensing image data is received, the remote sensing image data is processed by respectively utilizing different convolutional neural network algorithms to obtain a plurality of characteristic vectors, the prediction result matched with each obtained characteristic vector is respectively obtained, and the obtained prediction results are fused to obtain the image type of the remote sensing image data, so that the time for extracting the characteristic vectors is reduced, the extraction efficiency is improved and the identification efficiency is further improved under the condition that the information of the remote sensing image can not be lost when the remote sensing image is identified.']

Name: 57_food_tea_cooking_meal
Representative_Docs: ['The invention provides a method for calculating the nutrient content of food, which comprises the following steps: determining the type and number of foods to which the target food belongs from the obtained target picture based on the food characteristics; determining a total weight of the food from the target picture based on digital information characterizing the number; determining the weight of each food according to the food type, the number and the total weight; and determining the nutritional ingredients of each food in the target picture according to the weight fractions and the corresponding relation table of the food weight and the nutritional ingredients. It can be seen that the nutritional content of the food in the picture can be identified by this method.', 'The application discloses an intelligent refrigerator and a food material identification method. In the embodiment of the application, the characteristic extraction of the food materials and the retrieval and identification of the food materials are divided into different stages through a preset characteristic library. The method comprises the following steps of realizing characteristic extraction of food materials in the first stage, and performing characteristic retrieval and identification on the food materials based on a preset characteristic library in the second stage. Therefore, the method for extracting the features can realize the adaptability adjustment of the newly added food material types by maintaining the preset feature library without changing. In addition, in the embodiment of the application, in order to simplify the food material types to be identified, improve the identification effect of the food materials, and realize dynamic food material identification, that is, the accessed food materials are identified in the process of accessing the food materials. In addition, according to the method and the device, the preset feature library can be dynamically updated by the user according to human-computer interaction, so that the real-time dynamic learning of the food material types and features is realized.', 'An embodiment of the present invention discloses a method for managing nutrition and disease using a food image. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining an image including information on food; determining the food included in the image; and creating management information according to the food. The step of determining the food transmits a plurality of items obtaining a value equal to or greater than a predetermined similarity value and determines an item selected by a user client of the items as food selected by a user when type of the food may not be determined.']

Name: 58_memory_circuit_first_second
Representative_Docs: ['To provide a semiconductor device which can execute the product-sum operation. The semiconductor device includes a first memory cell, a second memory cell, and an offset circuit. First analog data is stored in the first memory cell, and reference analog data is stored in the second memory cell. The first memory cell and the second memory cell supply a first current and a second current, respectively, when a reference potential is applied as a selection signal. The offset circuit has a function of supplying a third current corresponding to a differential current between the first current and the second current. In the semiconductor device, the first memory and the second memory supply a fourth current and a fifth current, respectively, when a potential corresponding to second analog data is applied as a selection signal. By subtracting the third current from a differential current between the fourth current and the fifth current, a current that depends on the sum of products of the first analog data and the second analog data is obtained.', 'The invention discloses a memory calculation unit, a memory calculation method, a memory calculation block and a neural network circuit component, which relate to the field of electronic circuits, wherein the memory calculation unit comprises a static random access circuit unit, at least one nonvolatile storage unit and a logic gate circuit unit, the static random access circuit unit is provided with a first voltage end and a second voltage end, the first voltage end and the second voltage end are respectively provided with a first voltage and a second voltage, weight information is determined according to the values of the first voltage and the second voltage, the nonvolatile storage unit is connected with the first voltage end or the second voltage end, and two input ends of the logic gate circuit unit are respectively connected with the second voltage end and an input line. The storage and calculation unit provided by the invention can carry out multiplication calculation in a digital domain, improves the accuracy of calculation results and has the advantage of high energy efficiency. And the memory computing circuit adopts a nonvolatile memory unit, so that data can be ensured not to be lost when power is off, and the power consumption overhead is greatly reduced.', 'A memory device is provided. The memory device comprises a memory cell array configured to store data, a command decoder configured to receive a command from the exterior to generate a first memory cell control signal, a PIM (Processor In Memory) block configured to generate a second memory cell control signal including a command for performing an internal processing operation on the basis of instructions stored therein and perform an internal processing operation on the basis of the second memory cell control signal, and an operating mode multiplexer configured to output any one of the first memory cell control signal and the second memory cell control signal and provide it to the memory cell array.']

Name: 59_superresolution_reconstruction_image_resolution
Representative_Docs: ['The invention discloses a document super-resolution reconstruction method based on edge information guidance, which comprises the steps of acquiring a training data set and processing the training data set; extracting shallow low resolution image information using a convolution layer; extracting edge information in the low-resolution image by adopting a multi-scale cavity convolution and an image pyramid; extracting deep image information by adopting an RSTB block and residual connection, and outputting a feature map; the weighted fusion of the edge information and the output feature image is adopted, and the weighted fusion is sent to an up-sampling layer of a reconstruction module to guide image reconstruction; the features are upsampled using a subpixel convolutional layer. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: the model can effectively improve the super-resolution reconstruction effect of the document image. The quality of the reconstruction result is obviously improved, so that the application in the field of image processing is more reliable and efficient, the method can be effectively applied to the problem of super-resolution reconstruction of document images, and the reconstructed document and text images have clear edges and full details.', 'The invention belongs to the field of image reconstruction and detection, in particular relates to a target detection system based on a multiscale fusion channel attention super-resolution reconstruction technology, and aims to solve the problems of low detection efficiency and insufficient detection precision in the prior art. The invention comprises the following steps: the target image acquisition unit is used for acquiring an image of a target to be detected, preprocessing the image, taking the preprocessed image as a low-resolution target image and transmitting the low-resolution target image to the super-resolution reconstruction unit; the super-resolution reconstruction unit is used for performing super-resolution reconstruction on the low-resolution image to obtain a high-resolution target image and transmitting the high-resolution target image to the target detection unit; the target detection unit is used for carrying out target detection on the high-resolution target image through a trained superresolution target detection model to obtain a target detection result; the superdivision target detection model is a target detection model constructed based on a convolutional neural network. The invention detects small targets and low-resolution targets, and has high detection precision and high efficiency.', 'The invention discloses a super-resolution reconstruction method based on SRCNN complementary modules, which belongs to the technical field of computer vision, and comprises the steps of preprocessing a data set and obtaining a low-resolution image by a bicubic linear interpolation method; the method comprises the steps of carrying out blocking processing on a low-resolution image and a corresponding original high-resolution image, taking a brightness channel of the blocked image block as input data of a reconstruction model, constructing the reconstruction model, initializing model parameters, determining a mean square error as a loss function, inputting the low-resolution image in a training set to obtain the reconstruction image, updating the model parameters by using an Adam optimizer, obtaining a trained reconstruction model through iterative computation, and inputting the low-resolution image into the trained reconstruction model to obtain the high-resolution image. The invention can supplement the information of 0 to the model, can improve the performance of the model, and can obtain the reconstructed high-resolution image after three-layer convolution operation.']

Name: 60_segmentation_medical_image_tumor
Representative_Docs: ['The invention discloses a medical image automatic segmentation method based on deep learning, which is specifically realized as follows: (1) Acquiring a manual segmentation result of an original medical image and a target area of a patient, and constructing a training data set related to a segmentation task; (2) Designing a deep U-shaped convolutional neural network model fusing a residual error module and an attention mechanism; (3) Constructing a mixed loss function by using the Dice and the binary cross entropy; (4) performing network training by using the training data set; (5) And dividing the target area in the test image by using the trained network. The invention relates to a full-automatic end-to-end medical image segmentation method which can effectively solve the problems of fuzzy segmentation boundary, low small target detection rate, unstable training process, difficult convergence and the like in the current deep learning image segmentation field.', 'The invention provides a method, a system, a terminal and a medium for efficient medical image segmentation, which comprise the following steps: acquiring a medical image training set, training a first segmentation network, and performing pre-segmentation on the medical image to obtain a segmentation feature map; optimizing the network parameters of the first segmentation network and the segmentation characteristic map to obtain a second segmentation network; iteratively updating the network parameters of the second segmentation network to be convergent based on a medical image training set to obtain a final medical image segmentation network; and inputting the medical image into the final medical image segmentation network to obtain a segmentation result. The invention has low precision of the network parameters and the segmentation characteristic graph, is simple to calculate, can quickly provide the segmentation result of the medical image, and is suitable for being applied to various medical equipment for auxiliary diagnosis.', 'The invention belongs to the technical field of medical image analysis and relates to a brain tumor segmentation method based on a boundary sensing mechanism, which comprises the steps of inputting T1, T1c, T2 and Flair images of brain tumors into a trained image segmentation model, outputting a prediction segmentation image by the trained image segmentation model, wherein the prediction segmentation image is a brain tumor MRI image which is obtained by prediction and has a complete tumor region, a tumor core region and an enhanced tumor region; the brain tumor segmentation method based on the boundary sensing mechanism provided by the invention integrates boundary information into an image segmentation model by introducing the boundary sensing mechanism, improves the distinguishing ability of the model to the characteristics, realizes accurate segmentation of tumor subregions, integrates different MRI sequence complementary information by adopting a multi-mode fusion method, comprehensively understands tumor characteristics, combines uncertainty quantification and uncertainty-based loss function, provides confidence measurement for segmentation results, enhances the accuracy and reliability of segmentation, and assists clinicians in evaluating prediction results.']

Name: 61_wireless_communication_radio_channel
Representative_Docs: ['Techniques are described for network nodes and wireless devices completing a task in a collaborative manner. An example wireless communication method includes transmitting, by a core network to a network node, information associated with a task, and then receiving, from the network node, a list of wireless devices. Another example wireless communication method includes receiving, by a network node from a core network, information associated with a task, and then transmitting, to the core network, a list of wireless devices. In both these example wireless communication methods, the list of wireless devices is determined based on at least the information.', 'A method of wireless communications by a user equipment (UE) includes communicating with a network based on a machine learning model for wireless communication. The method also includes monitoring a status of the machine learning model for wireless communication. The method further includes reporting the status of the machine learning model for wireless communication using a predetermined resource according to a predetermined format. The method also includes falling back to communicating with a fallback procedure, instead of the machine learning model for wireless communication, to maintain wireless communication with the network in response to the status of the machine learning model indicating a model failure.', 'A method and apparatus in a communication system are provided. An apparatus in a communication system may include: a receiver configured to receive a signal using a channel; a transmitter configured to transmit a representation of channel information associated with the channel; and at least one processor configured to determine a condition of the channel based on the signal and generate a representation of the channel information based on the condition of the channel using a machine learning model. A method in a communication system may include: physical layer information for a wireless device is determined at the wireless device, a representation of the physical layer information is generated using a machine learning model, and the representation of the physical layer information is transmitted from the wireless device.']

Name: 62_brain_electroencephalogram_eeg_signals
Representative_Docs: ['The invention discloses a graph attention network-based emotion electroencephalogram identification method and system, comprising the following steps of S1, wherein an experimental testee generates different emotion states under the influence of different emotion stimulating materials; acquiring an electroencephalogram signal of a tested person during emotional experience by using an electroencephalogram instrument; marking the electroencephalogram signals of each section as emotion labels of corresponding stimulation materials; s2, preprocessing the data; firstly, carrying out signal screening on an electroencephalogram signal, removing low-emotion response data in 3s before the beginning of an experiment, and removing bad channels and bad samples with poor data quality and large noise interference; then, dividing the electroencephalogram signal into segments fixed for 4 s; and finally, extracting differential entropy features from the EEG signals, and outputting the result as a feature signal, wherein the graph convolution neural network overcomes the limitation of the convolution neural network, can process the feature extraction problem of the space discrete data of the topological graph structure, and combines the graph convolution neural network with the emotion-related electroencephalogram channel, so that the potential performance of the network can be exerted.', 'A multichannel electroencephalogram signal monitoring method based on a time-space convolution neural network and application thereof preprocesses multichannel electroencephalogram signals collected from each testee in a simulated driving experiment: performing band-pass filtering and denoising on the original signals after the original signals are subjected to downsampling, deleting interference signals in the electroencephalogram signals by adopting an independent component analysis method to obtain normal electroencephalogram signals and fatigue electroencephalogram signals, and respectively dividing the normal electroencephalogram signals and the fatigue electroencephalogram signals of each testee into normal electroencephalogram signal samples and fatigue electroencephalogram signal samples which are not overlapped; establishing a space-time convolution neural network capable of acquiring the spatial relationship and the time dependency of the multi-channel electroencephalogram signals; the space-time convolution neural network is trained by adopting a ten-fold cross validation method, and a normal electroencephalogram signal sample and a fatigue electroencephalogram signal sample are divided into two types according to a waking stage and a fatigue stage, so that a classification result is obtained. The invention can realize effective identification and correct classification of the fatigue driving electroencephalogram signals and convert the signals into warning signals.', 'The invention relates to an electroencephalogram signal deep learning method for image label labeling, which uses sampling frequency Collecting brain electrical signals of a tested person; preprocessing the acquired electroencephalogram data, and filtering to obtain an original time sequence S; setting the downsampling frequency Downsampling the preprocessed electroencephalogram data to obtain a downsampled sequence Establishing a training set, a verification set and a test set; establishing an electroencephalogram model and training; inputting the brain electrical data in the test set into the brain electrical model Obtaining a prediction label of the picture; comparing the prediction label with an original label of a picture in a test set, and calculating the overall classification accuracy; performing picture task labeling through an electroencephalogram model, and simultaneously collecting electroencephalogram data of a data labeling person; after the synchronous preprocessing of the electroencephalogram data, the electroencephalogram data is input into an obtained electroencephalogram model, and the output category is used as a data tag.']

Name: 63_signal_modulation_channel_interference
Representative_Docs: ['The invention discloses a lightweight automatic modulation recognition method based on multichannel fusion, which mainly solves the problems of overlarge parameter quantity and low modulation recognition accuracy under low signal-to-noise ratio of the existing modulation network, and the implementation scheme is as follows: acquiring a radio modulation signal data set, and randomly dividing a training set, a verification set and a test set according to a proportion after encoding the radio modulation signal data set; constructing a multichannel input fusion convolution module, adding a plurality of characteristic dimension reduction modules, and connecting the characteristic dimension reduction modules with a global average pooling layer and a full connection layer to form a lightweight modulation network; iteratively training the network by using a training sample, verifying each generation of result by using a verification sample, and finally storing the network corresponding to the minimum verification loss; and inputting the test set sample into a trained lightweight modulation network to obtain a signal modulation type identification result. The invention greatly reduces the network parameter while improving the accuracy of the modulation signal identification, ensures that the network can be deployed in equipment with limited computing resources, and can be used for the modulation mode classification of a communication system.', 'The application provides a method and a device for identifying a signal modulation mode, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a receiving end signal; and inputting a receiving end signal into a pre-trained convolutional neural network model to obtain a signal modulation mode recognition result output by the convolutional neural network model, wherein the convolutional neural network model is a model obtained by training by using a training sample labeled with modulation mode category information in advance. In the present application, the identification of the signal modulation mode can be realized in the above manner.', 'The invention discloses a modulation signal identification method based on a neural network and application thereof. The method comprises the following steps: converting the modulation signal into at least two kinds of image data, wherein the at least two kinds of image data can represent at least two kinds of amplitude-frequency distribution statistical characteristics of the modulation signal, or phase transfer relation of the modulation signal along with time change, or time-frequency characteristics of the modulation signal, or distribution characteristics of the modulation signal in a polar coordinate system; and inputting the at least two kinds of image data into a recognition model based on a neural network, and outputting modulation signal classes. The invention simultaneously considers various characteristics of the modulation signal, converts the modulation signal into at least two image data and inputs the image data into the recognition model, thereby being more suitable for recognition of the modulation signal under the complex signal environment and having better recognition accuracy for various types of modulation signals.']

Name: 64_time_sequence_prediction_data
Representative_Docs: ['The embodiment of the application provides a training method of a time sequence prediction model, a time sequence prediction method and related products, wherein the training method comprises the following steps: acquiring a sample time sequence at a designated moment; inputting the sample time sequence into a time sequence feature extraction layer of a time sequence prediction model to be trained, and extracting a first time sequence; inputting the first time sequence into a time-frequency conversion layer of a time sequence prediction model, carrying out Fourier conversion on the first time sequence, and converting the first time sequence into a first frequency domain sequence with a specified sequence length, wherein the specified sequence length is smaller than the minimum sequence length of at least one first time sequence; inputting the first frequency domain sequence into an LSTM prediction layer of a time sequence prediction model to predict a second frequency domain sequence; inputting the second frequency domain sequence into a frequency conversion layer of the time sequence prediction model, and performing inverse Fourier transform on the second frequency domain sequence to obtain a second time sequence; and training the time sequence prediction model based on the loss value of the second time sequence to obtain a trained time sequence prediction model.', 'The application provides a time sequence prediction method and a time sequence prediction device, and relates to the field of artificial intelligence. When the time series prediction is carried out at the time t, the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first input, a second input and a third input, wherein the first input comprises historical data in a first time sequence corresponding to the time t, and the first time sequence is a target time sequence; the second input comprises a second time series, and the second time series is used for providing historical information for prediction of the time series at the time t; the third input comprises a first state value output at the time t-1, and the time t-1 is the last time of the time t; and obtaining a prediction result at the time t according to the historical data in the first time sequence corresponding to the time t, the second time sequence and the first state value output at the time t-1. The method enables the time series to take more historical information into consideration in the prediction process, so that the prediction effect of the time series can be improved.', 'The application discloses a time sequence prediction method, a time sequence prediction device, a time sequence prediction equipment, a time sequence prediction medium and a time sequence prediction product. The method comprises the following steps: sampling the historical time sequence for a plurality of times by using a prediction model to obtain a plurality of candidate time sequences; respectively carrying out feature extraction on each candidate time sequence by using a prediction model to obtain a plurality of data features; and respectively predicting a plurality of data features by using a prediction model to obtain a prediction time sequence corresponding to each candidate time sequence, and determining a future time sequence according to each prediction time sequence. The method can comprehensively characterize the change condition of the energy change value based on more characteristics. Further, the accuracy of the future time series predicted based on the extracted more features is higher. That is, the energy variation value in the future time series is more accurate.']

Name: 65_heart_electrocardiogram_signal_blood
Representative_Docs: ['The embodiment of the invention relates to an electrocardiogram automatic analysis method and a device based on artificial intelligence self-learning, wherein the method comprises the steps of data preprocessing, heart beat feature detection, interference signal detection and heart beat classification based on a deep learning method, signal quality evaluation and lead combination, heart beat examination, electrocardiogram event and parameter analysis and calculation, and finally report data is automatically output, so that an automatic analysis method of a complete and rapid process is realized. The electrocardiogram automatic analysis method can also record modification information of the automatic analysis result, collect the modified data and feed the data back to the deep learning model for continuous training, and continuously improve and promote the accuracy of the automatic analysis method.', 'The invention discloses a kind of electrocardiogram beat classification recognition methods and system, this method to include：Step S1：ECG signal in abnormal electrocardiogram database is pre-processed；Step S2：It is chosen from abnormal electrocardiogram database and passes through pretreated ECG signal, then extracted the heart from the pretreated ECG signal of the process of selection and clap, obtain the heart and clap sample set；Step S3：It is clapped from the heart and randomly selects a part of heart bat in sample set as training sample set, the heart of remainder, which is clapped, is used as test sample collection；Step S4：Training sample set is inputted in convolutional neural networks model and is trained, realizes the extraction of ECG signal feature, which includes spatial pyramid pond layer；Step S5：In characteristic information and test sample collection the input convolutional neural networks model that extraction is obtained, and classified to the output result of convolutional neural networks model using grader.The present invention can improve the accuracy rate of beat classification identification.', 'A system for predicting the severity of heart failure, which can predict heart failure severity with high accuracy based on a single electrocardiogram signal, may comprise: an electrocardiogram signal input unit that receives a single electrocardiogram signal and generates input data based on the single electrocardiogram signal; a heart rate learning model that pre-learns a heart rate corresponding to the single electrocardiogram signal based on electrocardiogram data set and calculates the heart rate based on spatial characteristics and temporal characteristics of the input data; and a heart failure severity determination unit that determines a heart failure severity of at least one of normal, mild, moderate, and severe based on the heart rate.']

Name: 66_vessel_blood_fundus_segmentation
Representative_Docs: ['The application provides a training method and device, and an application method and device of a blood vessel segmentation model. The training method of the blood vessel segmentation model comprises the following steps: extracting a blood vessel central line in the blood vessel sample image; determining the loss weight of each pixel point according to the distance between each pixel point in the blood vessel sample image and the blood vessel central line; determining a first loss function value according to the loss weight of each pixel point, a blood vessel segmentation label corresponding to the blood vessel sample image and a blood vessel segmentation result output by the blood vessel segmentation model; the vessel segmentation model is trained according to the first loss function value, the problem that the categories of different partial vessels are unbalanced can be solved, and the training effect and the segmentation effect are improved.', 'The invention relates to an eyeground blood vessel segmentation method based on a space and channel dual attention mechanism, which comprises the following steps: step 1, performing data preprocessing on an original fundus image; step 2, performing data amplification on the preprocessed fundus image; step 3, constructing a segmentation network DAU-net fusing a space and channel dual attention mechanism, sending the amplified images into the DAU-net for network training, and guiding the network training by using the loss between the network segmentation result and the corresponding artificially labeled blood vessel segmentation graph to obtain a trained fundus blood vessel segmentation model; and 4, inputting the to-be-segmented test fundus image into the fundus blood vessel segmentation model for segmentation processing to obtain a fundus blood vessel segmentation result.', 'The invention discloses a blood vessel image segmentation method, a device, equipment and a medium based on deep learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a blood vessel segmentation data set; performing data expansion processing on the blood vessel segmentation data set to obtain a blood vessel image to be processed; preprocessing the blood vessel image to be processed to obtain a training data set; constructing a blood vessel segmentation model through an UNET network according to the training data set; and determining an evaluation result of the blood vessel segmentation result according to the blood vessel segmentation model, wherein the evaluation result is used for determining a correctly predicted object and a incorrectly predicted object in the blood vessel segmentation result. The invention can improve the definition of the blood vessel edge segmentation and reduce the capillary vessel omission ratio, and can be widely applied to the technical field of artificial intelligence.']

Name: 67_wind_power_speed_prediction
Representative_Docs: ['The disclosure relates to a wind power prediction method, a model training method, a device, equipment and a medium. Acquiring real-time weather forecast data of a target wind power plant; processing the real-time weather forecast data by utilizing a pre-trained wind power prediction model to obtain real-time wind power prediction data of a target wind power plant; the wind power prediction model firstly utilizes second training data of a source wind power plant with longer running time to determine a wind power prediction meta-model of a target wind power plant, and then utilizes first training data of the target wind power plant to finely tune the wind power prediction meta-model. In this way, the trained wind power prediction model can be well adapted to wind power prediction of the target wind power plant, so that accuracy of wind power prediction results of the target wind power plant is guaranteed.', 'The application provides a short-term wind power prediction method and device based on deviation compensation and step migration. The method comprises the following steps: respectively cleaning historical wind power related data corresponding to each wind power plant by adopting a maximum correlation minimum redundancy algorithm to obtain sample data corresponding to each wind power plant; training a TCN-GRU neural network by adopting sample data corresponding to a first type wind power plant to obtain an initial wind power prediction model; performing step migration on the initial wind power prediction model by adopting sample data corresponding to the second type wind power plant to obtain a wind power prediction model; and inputting sample data of the preset wind power plant in a historical time period before the current moment into a wind power prediction model to obtain wind power prediction data of a preset time period after the current moment. The wind power prediction method improves the accuracy of wind power prediction and solves the problem of low accuracy of short-term power prediction of the wind power plant in the prior art.', 'The invention discloses a wind power prediction error probability calculation method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring historical wind power data and quality function parameters; generating a wind power prediction error model based on the wind power historical data and the quality function parameter fusion multisource information training; calculating wind power output based on the double-layer Monte Carlo sampling wind power prediction error model; and calculating a system reliability index by using the optimal power flow model and taking the minimum load as an objective function based on the historical wind power data and the wind power output. The invention also discloses a wind power prediction error probability calculation device and a readable storage medium. The wind power prediction method and the wind power prediction device can improve the accuracy of wind power prediction and the running reliability of the power system.']

Name: 68_crack_bridge_damage_concrete
Representative_Docs: ['The invention relates to the technical field of image recognition, in particular to an automatic bridge crack detection system integrating cyclic residual convolution and a context extractor network. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a bridge crack image by using an image acquisition device, and creating a bridge crack data set for training a deep learning model; creating a novel signature encoder-decoder network of standard convolution in the encoder replaced by a cyclic residual convolution block (RRCNN); using a context extractor network comprising a hole convolution, a dense hole convolution block (DAC), and a residual multi-core pooling block (RMP); constructing a bridge crack automatic detection model by combining a novel feature encoder-decoder network and a context extractor network; training a bridge crack automatic detection model through a bridge crack data set to obtain ideal accuracy; and inputting an image to be detected according to the parameters obtained by training, and outputting a result. The invention has the advantages of low labor cost, high detection precision, strong operability and the like.', 'The application belongs to the technical field of image processing, and relates to a bridge crack detection method, a device, computer equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving an original bridge picture sent by a user terminal; calling a trained UNet++ model, and inputting an original bridge picture into the trained UNet++ model to perform crack segmentation operation to obtain a crack binary image, wherein the UNet++ model is combined with a channel attention module and a space attention module; denoising the crack binary image according to an image morphology algorithm and a skeletonizing algorithm to obtain a denoising binary image; performing skeleton extraction operation on the denoising binary image according to a skeletonization algorithm to obtain fracture skeleton data; performing crack parameter calculation operation on the crack skeleton data according to a crack geometric parameter calculation method to obtain a crack calculation result; and outputting the crack calculation result to the user terminal. The method and the device can apply the crack detection technology based on the image to concrete crack detection, and realize automatic crack detection.', 'The invention discloses a bridge crack detection and positioning method based on CNN deep learning, which comprises the steps of firstly, segmenting a bridge image into a smaller bridge crack surface element image and a smaller bridge background surface element image by using a window sliding algorithm; meanwhile, identifying the bridge background surface element image and the bridge crack surface element image according to a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) -based DBCC classification model; then, detecting and positioning the bridge cracks on the whole bridge crack image by combining a window sliding algorithm; and finally, accelerating the algorithm by adopting a search strategy combining the image pyramid and the ROI. Compared with the traditional crack detection and positioning method, the bridge crack detection and positioning method provided by the invention not only has better detection effect and stronger generalization capability, but also is directly carried out based on the color image, and is also the characteristic which is not possessed by the traditional crack detection and positioning method.']

Name: 69_robot_control_robots_the
Representative_Docs: ['The invention provides a machine learning device and method, a robot control device, and a robot system. A robot machine learning device (5) for performing work by a person in cooperation with a robot (1) is provided with: a state observation unit (51) that observes a state variable indicating the state of the robot (1) while the robot and the robot (1) are performing work in cooperation; a determination data acquisition unit (52) that acquires determination data relating to at least one of the degree of burden on the person and the work efficiency; and a learning unit (54) that learns a training data set for setting the behavior of the robot (1) based on the state variables and the determination data.', 'An artificial intelligence server for controlling a plurality of robots includes a communication unit and a processor. The communication unit is configured to communicate with the plurality of robots. The processor is configured to receive information including an operation and a deployment area corresponding to each of the plurality of robots, determine a first route corresponding to a first operation corresponding to a first robot among the plurality of robots, if the first operation corresponding to the first robot includes an operation for moving out of a first deployment area corresponding to the first robot, determine an area on the determined first route, in which at least one robot is deployed, determine an associated operation between the first robot and a second robot, wherein the second robot is deployed in the determined area, and update a second operation corresponding to the second robot or a second deployment area corresponding to the second robot, based on the determined associated operation.', 'Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on computer storage media, for sharing learned information among robots. In some implementations, a robot obtains sensor data indicating characteristics of an object. The robot determines a classification for the object and generates an embedding for the object using a machine learning model stored by the robot. The robot stores the generated embedding and data indicating the classification for the object. The robot sends the generated embedding and the data indicating the classification to a server system. The robot receives, from the server system, an embedding generated by a second robot and a corresponding classification. The robot stores the received embedding and the corresponding classification in the local cache of the robot. The robot may then use the information in the cache to identify objects.']

Name: 70_cell_image_pathological_classification
Representative_Docs: ['The invention relates to the field of medical science and technology, and provides a cervical cell image anomaly detection method, device, equipment and medium, wherein the method is implemented by collecting cervical cell images to be detected in a microscope observation area; adjusting the focal length of a microscope to obtain a region of interest of the cervical cell image; determining the objective lens multiple corresponding to the current region of interest of the microscope, and adjusting the current objective lens multiple until a cervical cell image meeting the preset resolution is obtained;
