preprocessing the cervical cell image to obtain an image-enhanced cervical cell image; the pretreated cervical cell image is input into a pre-trained target network for detection, a detection result of whether the cervical cell image to be detected is abnormal or not is obtained, the cervical cell is observed by using a microscope, the cervical cell image is processed in a collecting mode and a pretreatment mode, the resolution, the precision and the quality of the cervical cell image are improved, and the cervical cell image abnormality detection efficiency is also improved.', 'The application provides a method, a device and electronic equipment for identifying cells in a cell cluster, which are suitable for identifying at least one cell cluster area image from a digital slice image to be detected, identifying each single cell area image and a standard cell image from the cell cluster area image aiming at each cell cluster area image, correspondingly comparing the single cell area image with the standard cell image aiming at each single cell area image in each cell cluster area image, determining whether the single cell in the single cell area image is a suspicious cell or not, inputting the suspicious cell image corresponding to each suspicious cell into a trained cell classification model, and determining whether target cells of a target type exist in the digital slice image. The application can improve the accuracy of identifying the target cells in the cell mass.', 'The invention discloses a cervical cell full-section classification method based on context modeling, which comprises the following steps: 1. obtaining a T-type cervical cell full-section sample; 2. constructing a cell detection and feature extraction module based on a fast Rcnn network, carrying out cell detection and feature extraction on a cervical cell full-section sample, extracting features of a fixed-size cell nucleus image, and obtaining feature sequences of cell nucleus images in different types of cell full-sections; 3. building a context modeling module integrating a bidirectional long-term and short-term memory network and an attention mechanism; 4. building a cervical cell full-section classifier; 5. and carrying out classification prediction on the cervical cell whole section. According to the invention, the information obtained by extracting the characteristics of the input cell nucleus images in the different cervical cell full sections is more effectively learned, so that the accurate classification of various different cervical cell full sections is completed, and the labeling cost of the current cervical cell classification method on the cell level can be effectively reduced.']

Name: 71_livestock_animal_pig_cow
Representative_Docs: ['The present invention relates to an apparatus and method for monitoring a growth trend of a livestock entity based on images to measure the growth rate of each livestock group. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the apparatus comprises: a data transmission and reception module; a memory in which an image-based livestock entity growth trend monitoring program is stored; and a processor executing the program stored in the memory. The program inputs images collected through at least one camera assigned to each livestock room into a livestock entity detection model to detect the size of each livestock entity, clusters the size of entities for each livestock room, and generates growth trend information on the basis of size information of each livestock entity. The livestock entity detection model is a model learned using training data which is labeled by an outline arranged adjacent to the body area of each livestock entity in an image taken in the bird view direction of each livestock from the top of the livestock room and the rotation angle, behavioral state, and size of each livestock entity, and outputs the size value of each livestock entity in a standing state with respect to the input image.', 'The invention discloses a group health-preserving pig identity recognition and health monitoring method based on computer vision, which comprises the steps of intercepting collected videos, obtaining images, measuring similarity between the images by utilizing a structural similarity index, removing extremely similar images, obtaining a pig face recognition data set and a live pig health monitoring data set, sending the pig face recognition data set into a convolutional neural network for pig face recognition, inputting the live pig health monitoring data set into a target detection algorithm for health monitoring, carrying out joint optimization on two tasks during training, and realizing synchronous improvement of pig face recognition precision and live pig health monitoring accuracy. The method judges the identity and the health state of the pig through the contactless camera data, is simple to operate, is convenient and quick, saves the time for monitoring the health state in a manual mode, provides a reference basis for the farmers in the farm, and has great application value.', 'The invention provides an intelligent monitoring method and system for abnormal livestock behaviors based on a time dimension, and relates to the technical field of animal husbandry phenotype identification and detection, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring video data and constructing a live pig behavior data set; performing behavior recognition on the preprocessed live pig data set by using SlowFast networks; according to the live pig behavior recognition result, carrying out duration statistics on live pig horizontal behaviors by using a behavior time statistics algorithm; and judging whether the duration of the behavior of the lying ground exceeds a threshold value according to the statistical result, if the duration of the behavior of the lying ground exceeds the threshold value, sending out early warning information and a visualized result of behavior monitoring of live pigs, and if the duration of the behavior of the lying ground does not exceed the threshold value, continuing to perform behavior identification and time statistics. The invention provides an intelligent monitoring method and system for abnormal livestock behaviors based on time dimension, which can reduce the cost of manually monitoring abnormal live pigs, reduce the time for discovering and isolating potentially diseased pigs and improve the live pig breeding quality.']

Name: 72_authentication_fingerprint_identity_vein
Representative_Docs: ['The invention discloses a kind of finger vein identification method and system based on unsupervised learning and deep layer network, its middle finger vein identification method includes：Finger vein image to be registered is pre-processed successively, obtains pretreated finger vein image to be registered；Feature extraction processing to be registered is carried out to pretreated finger vein image to be registered using trained deep neural network model, obtains the further feature to be registered for referring to vein image；And build the retention further feature template library after registration；Gather finger vein image to be identified and finger vein image to be identified is subjected to pretreatment and further feature processing successively, obtain finger vein image further feature to be identified；Classification and matching identifying processing is carried out to finger vein image further feature to be identified and the retention further feature template library after registration using Softmax graders, obtains match cognization result.In embodiments of the present invention, the finger vein further feature of deeper can be extracted, and match cognization efficiency is faster, more accurately.', 'The present invention relates to a high-performance deep learning finger vein authentication system capable of simultaneously measuring a health state of an individual and high-performance deep learning finger vein authentication which can simultaneously measure a health state of an individual and high-performance deep learning finger vein authentication, and to a method thereof. The finger vein authentication process uses light from a light source of 850 nm to acquire an image of a finger through which near-infrared rays have passed, acquires the finger edge to distinguish the finger from an image of the finger illuminated by the 850 nm light source, and then correctly moves a slightly twisted finger to increase accuracy through certain authentication. Using the finger image, a certain region is used as a region of interest (ROI) to be used for authentication, centered on a part of a node where the near-infrared rays in the finger pass the brightest. After that, using DenseNet of CNN technology, which is high-performance deep learning, values (weight, bias) are generated for deriving and storing features in finger vein images through a modeling (training) process. The generated values are used to quickly authenticate the finger veins of a user when the system is actually used, and it is possible to distinguish and identify the user with higher accuracy than the existing finger vein authentication algorithm.', 'The invention discloses a kind of finger vein identification method, device, computer equipment and storage mediums, are related to artificial intelligence field.This refers to that vein identification method includes: to obtain finger vein image to be identified and finger vein image to be compared；Finger vein image to be identified and finger vein image to be compared are input to and referred in hand vein recognition model, wherein refers to that hand vein recognition model is obtained using twin neural metwork training；By referring to hand vein recognition model extraction first eigenvector relevant to finger vein image to be identified and second feature vector relevant with finger vein image to be compared；Finger hand vein recognition is carried out according to first eigenvector and second feature vector, judges whether finger vein image to be identified and finger vein image to be compared come from same root finger.Refer to that vein identification method can accurately carry out referring to vein image identification using this.']

Name: 73_hyperspectral_spectrum_classification_spectral
Representative_Docs: ['The invention provides a method for realizing remote sensing hyperspectral image classification based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps: acquiring hyperspectral image data; inputting the hyperspectral data into a residual depth separable convolution model for data extraction to obtain an output result; and classifying the output result to obtain a classification result of the ground coverage condition of the hyperspectral image data. The residual depth separable convolution model provided by the invention combines three-dimensional residual calculation, an SE block and an attention mechanism. The model can effectively extract abundant spectrum and space characteristics from hyperspectral image data, and can be used for classifying the multispectral images at the pixel level. Secondly, the invention also improves the calculation method of the attention score in the transducer module so as to better capture the dependency relationship among pixels and realize better hyperspectral image classification result. Again, experiments were performed on the three disclosed data sets, and the framework of the present invention achieved the most advanced level in pixel-level classification of multispectral images.', 'The invention discloses a medical hyperspectral image classification method based on a spatial spectrum joint attention mechanism, which belongs to the field of image processing and comprises the following steps of: all N pieces of hyperspectral image data form a data set D, and the data set D is divided into a training set and a testing set; giving importance weight to each wave band of the hyperspectral image; constructing a hyperspectral image reconstruction network capable of reserving space resolution, and learning low-dimensional features of the hyperspectral image; and inputting the low-dimensional features into a pyramid pooling dual-attention lightweight residual classification network, and calculating to obtain a final classification result. The method and the device fully utilize the wave band information and the space information of the hyperspectral image in the image dimension reduction and classification process, realize the accurate classification of the medical hyperspectral image, and effectively improve the final classification precision.', 'The invention is suitable for the technical field of hyperspectral image classification, and provides a hyperspectral image classification system based on self-supervision learning. The invention also provides a hyperspectral image classification method based on self-supervision learning, which comprises the following steps of carrying out data processing and feature reconstruction on input hyperspectral image data, carrying out shallow feature extraction and long-distance dependent modeling on the hyperspectral image data after pretreatment, guiding a classification process by using parameters of a reconstruction path model, and outputting classification results of the features extracted by the classification path model. According to the method, the high-efficiency feature extraction and classification of the hyperspectral image data are realized through the self-supervision learning and combined classification encoder, and the classification precision and generalization capability are improved, so that the high-efficiency and robust hyperspectral image classification is realized, and the method has strong practicability and popularization.']

Name: 74_distributed_training_node_learning
Representative_Docs: ['The disclosure provides a distributed training method, a distributed training device, computer equipment and a storage medium, belongs to the technical field of distributed computing, and can solve the problem that the existing distributed training efficiency is low. The distributed training method comprises the steps of identifying computing resource types of all computing nodes in a server cluster, obtaining performance characteristics of different types of computing resources, sensing and modeling network topology structures of all computing nodes in the server cluster, analyzing network connection characteristics among all computing nodes, generating dynamic distributed training task scheduling requests by utilizing an intelligent scheduling algorithm according to the performance characteristics of all computing nodes and the network connection characteristics among all computing nodes, and distributing training tasks to corresponding computing nodes for training according to the dynamic distributed training task scheduling requests.', 'The invention discloses a method and a device for updating a distributed deep learning model, which are characterized in that by acquiring the real gradient value of the distributed deep learning model, and calculating according to the real gradient value and the formula to obtain a predicted gradient value, and updating model parameters of the distributed deep learning model by using the predicted gradient value. According to the invention, model parameters of the distributed deep learning model are updated through the predicted gradient values, the training time of continuous iteration of the model is reduced, and the training result of the predicted gradient values is equivalent to the standard synchronous random gradient descent SGD, so that the training efficiency and weak expansibility of the model are further improved.', 'The invention discloses a distributed training time prediction method and device for a large-scale GPU cluster, wherein the scheme is as follows: establishing a multi-layer perceptron model based on hardware characteristics of the GPU and structural characteristics of the neural network model, and predicting calculation time of the distributed training layer by layer; modeling a relationship between communication throughput and communication data volume of a single link in the GPU cluster by using a regression analysis method; obtaining a cluster communication model by analyzing the communication topology and the execution principle of a distributed training algorithm, and further predicting the communication time of the GPU cluster; and extracting a key path of the distributed training according to the parallel relation between calculation and communication, and obtaining the distributed training time based on the key path. The method is used for predicting the training time of the distributed training task before the distributed training task is actually deployed to the large-scale GPU cluster, so that researchers in the industry are guided to reasonably allocate GPU resources, the waste of time and resources is avoided, and the method has guiding significance for optimizing the distributed training performance.']

Name: 75_depth_camera_estimation_image
Representative_Docs: ['The embodiment of the application discloses an image depth estimation method, an image depth estimation device, electronic equipment and a computer storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: reducing the target image with the first size to a second size to obtain a target image with the second size; estimating the depth information of the target image with the second size through a primary network of a depth estimation model to obtain a first depth image with the second size, wherein the first depth image comprises depth information corresponding to each pixel point in the target image with the second size; processing the target image with the first size and the first depth image with the second size through a secondary network of the depth estimation model to obtain a second depth image with the first size; the second depth image comprises depth information corresponding to each pixel point in the target image with the first size. By implementing the embodiment of the application, the time efficiency of image depth estimation can be improved, and higher depth estimation accuracy can be kept.', 'The invention discloses a depth estimation model training method, a depth estimation model training device and a depth estimation model training medium, and relates to the technical field of automatic driving. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a target image and an adjacent frame image; constructing a depth estimation model and a pose transformation model; the depth estimation model comprises a coding network and a decoding network, wherein the coding network is added with a dense connection and channel attention mechanism to obtain feature maps of various scales; decoding the network fusion feature map to obtain depth estimation information; the pose transformation model acquires a pose transformation relation between the target image and the adjacent frame image; generating a reconstructed image based on the depth estimation information and the pose transformation relation; and constructing a loss function based on the reconstructed image and the target image, and completing the training of the depth estimation model by using the loss function. The method adds dense connection and channel attention mechanism in the coding network, the extracted features are more effective, comprehensive and accurate, and the accuracy and reasoning speed are improved under the condition that the number of layers of the model is increased less.', 'The embodiment of the application discloses an image processing method and device and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: carrying out depth prediction on an image to be processed to obtain initial depth prediction information of a scene in the image; and obtaining the depth information of the scene based on the initial depth prediction information and the sparse depth information of the scene. According to the depth estimation method and device, accurate depth information of a scene can be obtained, and accuracy of a depth estimation result is improved.']

Name: 76_radar_signal_target_array
Representative_Docs: ['After traditional radar signal classification method generallys use manual analysis, extracts various low probability of intercept radar signal characteristics, classification processing is carried out using the feature of extraction, but classification accuracy is lower in practical applications.The present invention is a kind of method that the analysis of combination pseudo NM-algebra intercepts and captures radar signal classification to low probability with novel convolutional neural networks model.Specific step is as follows：Step 1 intercepts and captures LPI radar signal；Step 2 carries out Wigner-Ville distribution processing to the radar signal of intercepting and capturing, obtains radar signal image；Step 3, to treated, radar signal image is normalized；Step 4 classifies to radar signal image based on the novel convolutional neural networks of the present invention；Step 5 exports LPI radar signal classification results.Radar signal classification method of the invention can automatically extract radar signal feature, with the increase of the radar signal data of collection, its accuracy classified can be promoted, it is a kind of radar signal classification method with adaptive ability, the electronic warfare capability for promoting China has great importance.', 'The application discloses a target detection method, electronic equipment and a computer storage medium, wherein the target detection method comprises the following steps: obtaining image data shot by an image pickup device, preprocessing the image data, obtaining radar data detected by a millimeter wave radar, preprocessing the radar data, and enabling the radar data and the image data to be respectively input into a convolutional neural network in the same scale; cascading the radar data and the image data in a plurality of layers of the convolutional neural network to obtain fusion data, and outputting a category detection result and a key point detection result of a target in the fusion data; and carrying out post-processing on the category detection result and the key point detection result so as to output the category and the motion state of the target. Through the mode, the radar data and the image data can be subjected to cascade fusion at a plurality of levels, and the characteristics of the radar data and the image data are fully fused, so that the accuracy and the robustness of target detection are improved.', 'The invention discloses a target identification method, a control system, a vehicle and a storage medium, wherein the target identification method comprises the steps of acquiring image data acquired by a camera module and acquiring radar original data acquired by a radar module, wherein the image data and the radar original data comprise at least one same detection target; processing and extracting image data to obtain image characteristics of a detection target, and processing and extracting radar original data to obtain radar characteristics of the detection target; carrying out feature combination processing on the image features and the radar features according to time and space on the same detection target to obtain fusion features of the detection target; and determining the identification result of the detection target according to the fusion characteristics. Compared with the traditional camera and millimeter wave radar fusion architecture, the invention can realize higher-precision detection, higher-precision identification and real-time tracking functions by carrying out feature combination according to the image features and the radar features.']

Name: 77_user_device_one_or
Representative_Docs: ['A computer-implemented method is provided including receiving sensor data from a mobile device corresponding to a first user. A user state of the first user is predicted based on the sensor data. A request is transmitted to the first user to confirm the predicted user state, and a notification is transmitted regarding the predicted user state to a second user responsive to the first user's confirmation of the predicted user state or the first user's failure to respond to the request. A computing system for monitoring and reporting activity of a mobile device is also provided.', 'In one embodiment, a current context of a mobile device may be ascertained, where the current context includes an indication of a last application opened via the mobile device, wherein the last application opened is one of a plurality of applications installed on the mobile device. A probability, for each of the plurality of applications, that a user of the mobile device will use the corresponding application under the current context may be determined, where the probability for at least a portion of the plurality of applications is determined by applying a computer-generated model to the current context, wherein the computer-generated model is associated with the mobile device. One or more of the plurality of the applications may be identified based, at least in part, upon the probability, for each one of the plurality of applications, that the user of the mobile device will use the corresponding application.', 'Disclosed is technique for a user context detection and interaction with a messaging service based on a user context in a messaging service environment. An interaction method of a mobile device may include acquiring information associated with a context of at least one of a mobile device and a user of the mobile device under control of an application installed and executed on the mobile device in association with a messaging service, determining a context of the user based on the acquired information, verifying a function to be provided to the user through the messaging service based on the determined context of the user, dynamically determining a configuration of a user interface based on the determined context of the user, and providing the function through the user interface of which the configuration is dynamically determined.']

Name: 78_ct_magnetic_image_imaging
Representative_Docs: ['Disclosed herein is a method of training an image processing neural network (100).The method comprises repeatedly: receiving (200) a training set of magnetic resonance images (600) each descriptive of a field of view (409) of a subject (418), wherein the training set of magnetic resonance images are acquired according to a synthetic magnetic resonance imaging protocol; receiving (202) at least one two-dimensional training magnetic resonance image (602) acquired from the field of view of the subject; positioning (204) the at least one two-dimensional training magnetic resonance image within a data structure (300) equivalent to the output layer of the image processing neural network; aligning (206) the training set of magnetic resonance images to match the positioning of the at least one two-dimensional training magnetic resonance image; and training (208) the image processing neural network using the aligned training set of magnetic resonance images and the data structure.', 'The invention belongs to the technical field of magnetic resonance imaging, and discloses a magnetic resonance image reconstruction method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of generating a space coding gradient field based on a plurality of paths of array gradient coils; the method comprises the steps of exciting an imaging object by using radio frequency signals in a space coding gradient field to enable the imaging object to generate magnetic resonance signals, using the space coding gradient field to carry out space coding on the magnetic resonance signals, collecting the magnetic resonance signals generated by the space coded imaging object to obtain undersampled signals, generating a coding matrix according to the space coding gradient field, carrying out imaging reconstruction according to the coding matrix and the undersampled signals to obtain a reconstructed image, and inputting the reconstructed image into a pre-trained neural network model to obtain a predicted image which is used as the magnetic resonance image. The invention can quickly reconstruct more accurate results under the condition of high data undersampling, and simultaneously, the method can effectively inhibit noise interference and improve signal to noise ratio.', 'The present application relates to a magnetic resonance image reconstruction method, apparatus, device, storage medium and program product, the method comprising: acquiring first magnetic resonance imaging data; the first magnetic resonance imaging data fills a partial encoding position of the K space; reconstructing the first magnetic resonance imaging data according to the first magnetic resonance imaging data and a preset neural network model to obtain a reconstructed image; the neural network model comprises a plurality of adjacent convolution modules, wherein at least one convolution module comprises a fitting recovery layer, a convolution layer and a data consistency layer; the magnetic resonance imaging data corresponding to the reconstructed image fills the partial coding position and the coding position except for the partial coding position of the K space. The method can reduce the calculated amount of the magnetic resonance image reconstruction and improve the imaging speed.']

Name: 79_transaction_fraud_account_payment
Representative_Docs: ['Provided are a method and a device for detecting an abnormal transaction, which detect an abnormal transaction based on transaction data used in an electronic financial transaction. The method for detecting an abnormal transaction performed by the device for detecting an abnormal transaction comprises the following steps of: obtaining first transaction data including a classification result indicating an abnormal transaction or a normal transaction and a second transaction data not including the classification result, wherein each of the first transaction data and the second transaction data is composed of a plurality of features; determining a key feature among the plurality of features composing the first transaction data by using a filter method-based feature selection algorithm; and performing an unsupervised learning-based clustering with respect to key feature data for the second transaction data, and constructing an abnormal transaction detection model by using a clustering result.', 'The embodiment of the invention provides a data detection method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: determining a target electronic currency transaction address to be transacted; obtaining a transaction record of a target electronic currency transaction address in a first preset time period as a first target transaction record; coding the first target transaction record by adopting a preset coding mode to obtain a target coding result; inputting a target coding result into a pre-constructed neural network model; the neural network model is used for: determining a fraud detection result of the electronic money transaction address corresponding to the target coding result; and obtaining a fraud detection result output by the neural network model as a fraud detection result of the target electronic currency transaction address. By applying the embodiment of the invention, whether the transaction to be carried out is a fraud transaction can be determined, thereby reducing the fraud transaction and protecting the asset security of the user.', 'The invention provides a fraud group identification system based on a transaction knowledge graph, which is characterized by comprising a data acquisition module, a transaction knowledge graph construction module, a fraud group identification module and a fraud risk display module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring and processing transaction data, the transaction knowledge graph construction module is used for carrying out knowledge extraction and knowledge representation on the transaction data to construct a corresponding transaction knowledge graph, the fraud group identification module is used for carrying out fraud identification on the transaction knowledge graph to obtain fraud risk data containing information such as fraud modes, and the fraud risk display module is used for providing visual risk display of the fraud risk data for a user.']

Name: 80_test_code_testing_case
Representative_Docs: ['The embodiment of the invention provides a test case acquisition method, which comprises the steps of generating a service case feature set according to case type data and a plurality of case description data in a test request, wherein the service case feature set comprises a plurality of common case features and a plurality of designated features associated with the plurality of case description data; according to the common example characteristics and the specified characteristics, acquiring candidate service test cases from a preset case library; encoding a plurality of candidate service test cases to obtain a plurality of individuals; combining a plurality of individuals to obtain an initial population; performing genetic iteration operation on a plurality of individuals in the initial population to generate a plurality of target test cases; pushing a plurality of target test cases to a test user side. According to the embodiment of the invention, the regression test is performed by acquiring a plurality of target test cases on the premise of ensuring the code coverage rate by combining the candidate business test cases with the genetic algorithm, so that the efficiency of the regression test is effectively improved.', 'Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to a method and device for executing test cases. The method comprises obtaining a set of test cases to be executed, and determining a test platform type and a test script associated with each test case in the set of test cases based on a knowledge base. The method further comprises dividing the set of test cases into a plurality of test subsets or test suites based on the test platform type, and executing test cases in each test subset using the respective test environment and test script. In embodiments of the present disclosure, the plurality of test suites are generated automatically based on the knowledge base, and the respective test environment and test script are used for executing each test suite. Accordingly, embodiments of the present disclosure can implement automatic generation and execution of the test suites, and can improve the operation efficiency for test cases.', 'The present application relates to the field of software testing technologies, and in particular, to a software testing method, device and equipment. According to the method, the test priorities of all modules of an object to be tested are identified, a plurality of test cases are matched with all the modules according to the test priorities, different test weights are distributed for all the test cases, then the execution paths of the test cases are crossed and mutated according to the test weights and the test priorities through a genetic algorithm, the optimal test case execution paths are determined, in the test process, test defect feedback is carried out in real time according to test results through a reinforcement learning algorithm, the test priorities of all the modules of the object to be tested and the test weights of the test cases are adjusted through a reward function according to the defect feedback results, so that a software test platform can carry out self-adaptive adjustment on the test execution paths according to the test results, the test efficiency is greatly improved, and the defect discovery rate is also improved.']

Name: 81_lung_nodule_xray_ct
Representative_Docs: ['The invention discloses a method and a system for screening false positive of lung nodules based on a convolutional neural network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring coordinate positions and maximum radius values of the lung nodule candidates from lung CT image data; extracting original 3D image data of the candidate lung nodule from the lung CT image data according to the coordinate position and the maximum radius value, and carrying out interpolation processing on the original 3D image data; obtaining sample data of three planes corresponding to the 3D image data of the lung nodule candidate obtained through interpolation, and scaling the sample data of the three planes to form a training set; and training the convolutional neural network based on the training set, and performing false positive screening on the candidate lung nodule through a convolutional neural network model obtained through training. The embodiment of the invention can solve the problem of high false positive rate in the process of identifying the lung nodule in the existing end-to-end network, and improves the accuracy of computer-aided automatic detection of the lung nodule.', 'The invention discloses a lung nodule false positive screening method based on a convolutional neural network, which comprises the following steps: (1) obtaining a pulmonary nodule detection result output by the pulmonary nodule detection model; (2) marking the lung nodule detection result to generate a sample; (3) constructing a data set according to the sample and the original lung CT image; (4) carrying out random offset in 8 directions on the coordinate X of each data pair in the data set, wherein the offset scale is 0.5X; (5) cutting an original lung CT image according to a sample for each data pair in the data set to obtain training samples with different sizes, and performing augmentation processing on the training samples; (6) constructing a convolutional neural network; (7) training the convolutional neural network by using the training sample with the size of 3 to obtain three lung nodule false positive screening models; (8) and predicting the sample to be tested by using the lung nodule false positive screening model, and outputting a prediction result.', 'The invention provides a lung nodule detection method and device based on a neural network and image processing equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, identifying and segmenting lung nodules in a CT image based on a 3D DCNN network frame to obtain candidate lung nodule data; s2, constructing a characteristic value vector of the candidate lung nodule data in the CT image to obtain a sample data set; s3, dividing the sample data set into a training set and a testing set according to the proportion, classifying and training the training set by utilizing a pre-constructed GRU model, inputting the testing set into the trained GRU model for detection, and outputting a lung nodule detection result. After automatic detection and segmentation based on CT lung images, feature values are extracted and constructed for focus areas, neural network modeling is utilized to detect lung nodule candidate areas, false positives are reduced, and therefore accuracy of automatic detection of lung images is improved.']
